"use client";

import {
	type KeyboardEvent as ReactKeyboardEvent,
	type PointerEvent as ReactPointerEvent,
	useRef,
} from "react";

import { serializePath } from "./parse";
import type { Anchor, Vec, VectorPath } from "./types";
import { add, sub, v } from "./types";

export type Mirror = "none" | "angle" | "angle-length";

export interface EditorStyle {
	accent: string;
	arm: string;
	anchorR: number;
	handleR: number;
	pointFill: string;
	fill: string;
	fillOpacity: number;
	stroke: string;
	strokeWidth: number;
	showRig: boolean;
	fillRule: "nonzero" | "evenodd";
}

export const DEFAULT_EDITOR: EditorStyle = {
	accent: "#0d99ff",
	arm: "#9bb7d4",
	anchorR: 4,
	handleR: 3.2,
	pointFill: "var(--background)",
	fill: "#0d99ff",
	fillOpacity: 0.08,
	stroke: "#0d99ff",
	strokeWidth: 1.5,
	showRig: true,
	fillRule: "evenodd",
};

type Drag =
	| { kind: "anchor"; index: number; offset: Vec }
	| {
			kind: "handle";
			index: number;
			side: "in" | "out";
			mirror: Mirror;
			offset: Vec;
	  };

function arrowDelta(key: string, amount: number): Vec | null {
	switch (key) {
		case "ArrowLeft":
			return v(-amount, 0);
		case "ArrowRight":
			return v(amount, 0);
		case "ArrowUp":
			return v(0, -amount);
		case "ArrowDown":
			return v(0, amount);
		default:
			return null;
	}
}

export function VectorEditor({
	path,
	onChange,
	style = DEFAULT_EDITOR,
	mirror = "angle-length",
	viewBox,
	width,
	height,
	className,
	ariaLabel = "Editable vector",
	ariaDescribedBy,
}: {
	path: VectorPath;
	onChange: (next: VectorPath) => void;
	style?: EditorStyle;
	mirror?: Mirror;
	viewBox: [number, number, number, number];
	width?: number;
	height?: number;
	className?: string;
	ariaLabel?: string;
	ariaDescribedBy?: string;
}) {
	const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null);
	const drag = useRef<Drag | null>(null);
	const pathRef = useRef(path);
	pathRef.current = path;
	const pending = useRef<Vec | null>(null);
	const animationFrame = useRef(0);

	function toUser(event: { clientX: number; clientY: number }): Vec {
		const svg = svgRef.current;
		const matrix = svg?.getScreenCTM();
		if (!svg || !matrix) return v(0, 0);
		const point = svg.createSVGPoint();
		point.x = event.clientX;
		point.y = event.clientY;
		const transformed = point.matrixTransform(matrix.inverse());
		return v(transformed.x, transformed.y);
	}

	function startAnchor(event: ReactPointerEvent, index: number) {
		if (drag.current) return;
		event.stopPropagation();
		(event.currentTarget as Element).setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
		const position = pathRef.current.anchors[index].p;
		drag.current = {
			kind: "anchor",
			index,
			offset: sub(position, toUser(event)),
		};
	}

	function startHandle(
		event: ReactPointerEvent,
		index: number,
		side: "in" | "out",
	) {
		if (drag.current) return;
		event.stopPropagation();
		(event.currentTarget as Element).setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
		const anchor = pathRef.current.anchors[index];
		const position = anchor[side];
		if (!position) return;
		drag.current = {
			kind: "handle",
			index,
			side,
			mirror: event.altKey ? "none" : mirror,
			offset: sub(position, toUser(event)),
		};
	}

	function applyDrag(activeDrag: Drag, pointer: Vec): VectorPath {
		const anchors = pathRef.current.anchors.map((anchor) => ({
			p: { ...anchor.p },
			in: anchor.in ? { ...anchor.in } : null,
			out: anchor.out ? { ...anchor.out } : null,
		})) as Anchor[];
		const target = add(pointer, activeDrag.offset);
		const anchor = anchors[activeDrag.index];

		if (activeDrag.kind === "anchor") {
			const delta = sub(target, anchor.p);
			anchor.p = target;
			if (anchor.in) anchor.in = add(anchor.in, delta);
			if (anchor.out) anchor.out = add(anchor.out, delta);
		} else {
			anchor[activeDrag.side] = target;
			const other = activeDrag.side === "out" ? anchor.in : anchor.out;
			if (activeDrag.mirror !== "none" && other) {
				const relative = sub(target, anchor.p);
				const relativeLength = Math.hypot(relative.x, relative.y) || 1;
				const length =
					activeDrag.mirror === "angle-length"
						? relativeLength
						: Math.hypot(other.x - anchor.p.x, other.y - anchor.p.y);
				const opposite = {
					x: anchor.p.x - (relative.x / relativeLength) * length,
					y: anchor.p.y - (relative.y / relativeLength) * length,
				};
				if (activeDrag.side === "out") anchor.in = opposite;
				else anchor.out = opposite;
			}
		}

		return {
			anchors,
			starts: pathRef.current.starts,
			closed: pathRef.current.closed,
		};
	}

	function commit(next: VectorPath) {
		pathRef.current = next;
		onChange(next);
	}

	function onMove(event: ReactPointerEvent) {
		if (!drag.current) return;
		pending.current = toUser(event);
		if (animationFrame.current) return;
		animationFrame.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
			animationFrame.current = 0;
			if (drag.current && pending.current) {
				commit(applyDrag(drag.current, pending.current));
			}
		});
	}

	function endDrag(event: ReactPointerEvent) {
		if (!drag.current) return;
		if (animationFrame.current) {
			cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame.current);
			animationFrame.current = 0;
			if (pending.current) commit(applyDrag(drag.current, pending.current));
		}
		try {
			(event.target as Element).releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
		} catch {
			// Pointer capture may already be released by the browser.
		}
		drag.current = null;
		pending.current = null;
	}

	function nudge(event: ReactKeyboardEvent, activeDrag: Drag, position: Vec) {
		const delta = arrowDelta(event.key, event.shiftKey ? 10 : 1);
		if (!delta) return;
		event.preventDefault();
		commit(applyDrag({ ...activeDrag, offset: v(0, 0) }, add(position, delta)));
	}

	const d = serializePath(path);
	const arms: { ax: number; ay: number; hx: number; hy: number }[] = [];
	if (style.showRig) {
		for (const anchor of path.anchors) {
			if (anchor.out) {
				arms.push({
					ax: anchor.p.x,
					ay: anchor.p.y,
					hx: anchor.out.x,
					hy: anchor.out.y,
				});
			}
			if (anchor.in) {
				arms.push({
					ax: anchor.p.x,
					ay: anchor.p.y,
					hx: anchor.in.x,
					hy: anchor.in.y,
				});
			}
		}
	}

	return (
		<svg
			ref={svgRef}
			role="application"
			aria-label={ariaLabel}
			aria-describedby={ariaDescribedBy}
			viewBox={viewBox.join(" ")}
			width={width ?? viewBox[2]}
			height={height ?? viewBox[3]}
			className={className}
			style={{
				display: "block",
				overflow: "visible",
				touchAction: "none",
				userSelect: "none",
			}}
			onPointerMove={onMove}
			onPointerUp={endDrag}
			onPointerCancel={endDrag}
		>
			<path
				d={d}
				fill={style.fill}
				fillRule={style.fillRule}
				fillOpacity={style.fillOpacity}
				stroke={style.stroke}
				strokeWidth={style.strokeWidth}
			/>

			{style.showRig ? (
				<g>
					<g
						stroke={style.arm}
						strokeWidth={Math.max(0.75, style.strokeWidth * 0.6)}
					>
						{arms.map((arm, index) => (
							<line
								key={`${arm.ax}-${arm.ay}-${arm.hx}-${arm.hy}-${index}`}
								x1={arm.ax}
								y1={arm.ay}
								x2={arm.hx}
								y2={arm.hy}
							/>
						))}
					</g>

					{path.anchors.map((anchor, index) => (
						<g key={`handles-${index}`}>
							{anchor.out ? (
								<Diamond
									cx={anchor.out.x}
									cy={anchor.out.y}
									r={style.handleR}
									fill={style.pointFill}
									stroke={style.accent}
									label={`Outgoing handle ${index + 1}. Use arrow keys to move.`}
									onPointerDown={(event) => startHandle(event, index, "out")}
									onKeyDown={(event) =>
										nudge(
											event,
											{
												kind: "handle",
												index,
												side: "out",
												mirror: event.altKey ? "none" : mirror,
												offset: v(0, 0),
											},
											anchor.out as Vec,
										)
									}
								/>
							) : null}
							{anchor.in ? (
								<Diamond
									cx={anchor.in.x}
									cy={anchor.in.y}
									r={style.handleR}
									fill={style.pointFill}
									stroke={style.accent}
									label={`Incoming handle ${index + 1}. Use arrow keys to move.`}
									onPointerDown={(event) => startHandle(event, index, "in")}
									onKeyDown={(event) =>
										nudge(
											event,
											{
												kind: "handle",
												index,
												side: "in",
												mirror: event.altKey ? "none" : mirror,
												offset: v(0, 0),
											},
											anchor.in as Vec,
										)
									}
								/>
							) : null}
						</g>
					))}

					{path.anchors.map((anchor, index) => (
						<g
							key={`anchor-${index}`}
							role="button"
							tabIndex={0}
							aria-label={`Anchor ${index + 1}. Use arrow keys to move.`}
							className="group outline-none"
							style={{ cursor: "grab" }}
							onPointerDown={(event) => startAnchor(event, index)}
							onKeyDown={(event) =>
								nudge(
									event,
									{ kind: "anchor", index, offset: v(0, 0) },
									anchor.p,
								)
							}
						>
							<circle
								cx={anchor.p.x}
								cy={anchor.p.y}
								r={style.anchorR * 3}
								fill="transparent"
							/>
							<circle
								cx={anchor.p.x}
								cy={anchor.p.y}
								r={style.anchorR * 1.8}
								fill="none"
								stroke={style.accent}
								strokeWidth={1}
								className="opacity-0 group-focus-visible:opacity-100"
							/>
							<circle
								cx={anchor.p.x}
								cy={anchor.p.y}
								r={style.anchorR}
								fill={style.pointFill}
								stroke={style.accent}
								strokeWidth={1.25}
							/>
						</g>
					))}
				</g>
			) : null}
		</svg>
	);
}

function Diamond({
	cx,
	cy,
	r,
	fill,
	stroke,
	label,
	onPointerDown,
	onKeyDown,
}: {
	cx: number;
	cy: number;
	r: number;
	fill: string;
	stroke: string;
	label: string;
	onPointerDown: (event: ReactPointerEvent<SVGGElement>) => void;
	onKeyDown: (event: ReactKeyboardEvent<SVGGElement>) => void;
}) {
	return (
		<g
			role="button"
			tabIndex={0}
			aria-label={label}
			className="group outline-none"
			style={{ cursor: "grab" }}
			onPointerDown={onPointerDown}
			onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
		>
			<circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r * 3.5} fill="transparent" />
			<circle
				cx={cx}
				cy={cy}
				r={r * 1.8}
				fill="none"
				stroke={stroke}
				strokeWidth={1}
				className="opacity-0 group-focus-visible:opacity-100"
			/>
			<rect
				x={cx - r}
				y={cy - r}
				width={r * 2}
				height={r * 2}
				fill={fill}
				stroke={stroke}
				strokeWidth={1.1}
				style={{
					transform: "rotate(45deg)",
					transformBox: "fill-box",
					transformOrigin: "50% 50%",
				}}
			/>
		</g>
	);
}

import type { Anchor, Vec, VectorPath } from "./types";
import { subRange, v } from "./types";

type Token = { cmd: string; args: number[] };

function tokenize(d: string): Token[] {
	const tokens: Token[] = [];
	const pattern = /([MmLlHhVvCcSsQqTtAaZz])|(-?\d*\.?\d+(?:e[-+]?\d+)?)/gi;
	let match = pattern.exec(d);
	let current: Token | null = null;

	while (match) {
		if (match[1]) {
			current = { cmd: match[1], args: [] };
			tokens.push(current);
		} else if (current) {
			current.args.push(Number.parseFloat(match[2]));
		}
		match = pattern.exec(d);
	}

	return tokens;
}

export function parsePath(d: string): VectorPath {
	const tokens = tokenize(d);
	const anchors: Anchor[] = [];
	const starts: number[] = [];
	const closed: boolean[] = [];
	let current = v(0, 0);
	let start = v(0, 0);
	let previousControl: Vec | null = null;
	let previousCommand = "";

	const push = (p: Vec) => anchors.push({ p, out: null, in: null });
	const last = () => anchors[anchors.length - 1];
	const dedupeClose = () => {
		if (!starts.length) return;
		const startIndex = starts.at(-1) ?? 0;
		if (anchors.length - startIndex < 2) return;

		const first = anchors[startIndex].p;
		const final = anchors.at(-1);
		if (
			final &&
			Math.abs(first.x - final.p.x) < 0.01 &&
			Math.abs(first.y - final.p.y) < 0.01
		) {
			anchors[startIndex].in = final.in;
			anchors.pop();
		}
	};

	for (const { cmd, args } of tokens) {
		const relative = cmd === cmd.toLowerCase();
		const command = cmd.toUpperCase();
		let index = 0;
		const number = () => args[index++];
		const point = (): Vec => {
			const x = number();
			const y = number();
			return relative ? { x: current.x + x, y: current.y + y } : { x, y };
		};

		switch (command) {
			case "M": {
				if (starts.length && closed.at(-1)) dedupeClose();
				current = point();
				start = current;
				starts.push(anchors.length);
				closed.push(false);
				push(current);
				while (index < args.length) {
					current = point();
					push(current);
				}
				previousControl = null;
				break;
			}
			case "L": {
				while (index < args.length) {
					current = point();
					push(current);
				}
				previousControl = null;
				break;
			}
			case "H": {
				while (index < args.length) {
					const x = number();
					current = { x: relative ? current.x + x : x, y: current.y };
					push(current);
				}
				previousControl = null;
				break;
			}
			case "V": {
				while (index < args.length) {
					const y = number();
					current = { x: current.x, y: relative ? current.y + y : y };
					push(current);
				}
				previousControl = null;
				break;
			}
			case "C": {
				while (index < args.length) {
					const firstControl = point();
					const secondControl = point();
					const end = point();
					last().out = firstControl;
					push(end);
					last().in = secondControl;
					current = end;
					previousControl = secondControl;
				}
				break;
			}
			case "S": {
				while (index < args.length) {
					const canReflect =
						previousCommand === "C" || previousCommand === "S" || index > 0;
					const firstControl = canReflect
						? {
								x: 2 * current.x - (previousControl?.x ?? current.x),
								y: 2 * current.y - (previousControl?.y ?? current.y),
							}
						: current;
					const secondControl = point();
					const end = point();
					last().out = firstControl;
					push(end);
					last().in = secondControl;
					current = end;
					previousControl = secondControl;
				}
				break;
			}
			case "Q": {
				while (index < args.length) {
					const quadraticControl: Vec = point();
					const end = point();
					last().out = {
						x: current.x + (2 / 3) * (quadraticControl.x - current.x),
						y: current.y + (2 / 3) * (quadraticControl.y - current.y),
					};
					push(end);
					last().in = {
						x: end.x + (2 / 3) * (quadraticControl.x - end.x),
						y: end.y + (2 / 3) * (quadraticControl.y - end.y),
					};
					current = end;
					previousControl = quadraticControl;
				}
				break;
			}
			case "T": {
				while (index < args.length) {
					const canReflect =
						previousCommand === "Q" || previousCommand === "T" || index > 0;
					const quadraticControl: Vec = canReflect
						? {
								x: 2 * current.x - (previousControl?.x ?? current.x),
								y: 2 * current.y - (previousControl?.y ?? current.y),
							}
						: current;
					const end = point();
					last().out = {
						x: current.x + (2 / 3) * (quadraticControl.x - current.x),
						y: current.y + (2 / 3) * (quadraticControl.y - current.y),
					};
					push(end);
					last().in = {
						x: end.x + (2 / 3) * (quadraticControl.x - end.x),
						y: end.y + (2 / 3) * (quadraticControl.y - end.y),
					};
					current = end;
					previousControl = quadraticControl;
				}
				break;
			}
			case "Z": {
				if (closed.length) closed[closed.length - 1] = true;
				current = start;
				previousControl = null;
				break;
			}
			case "A":
				throw new Error(
					"Arc commands (A) are not supported by the point editor.",
				);
			default:
				throw new Error(`Unsupported path command: ${cmd}`);
		}

		previousCommand = command;
	}

	if (starts.length && closed.at(-1)) dedupeClose();
	return { anchors, starts, closed };
}

const formatNumber = (value: number) => String(Math.round(value * 100) / 100);

export function serializePath(path: VectorPath): string {
	const { anchors, starts, closed } = path;
	if (!anchors.length || !starts.length) return "";
	const parts: string[] = [];

	for (let index = 0; index < starts.length; index++) {
		const [begin, end] = subRange(path, index);
		const count = end - begin;
		if (!count) continue;

		parts.push(
			`M ${formatNumber(anchors[begin].p.x)} ${formatNumber(anchors[begin].p.y)}`,
		);
		const segmentCount = closed[index] ? count : count - 1;

		for (let segment = 0; segment < segmentCount; segment++) {
			const anchor = anchors[begin + segment];
			const next = anchors[begin + ((segment + 1) % count)];
			if (anchor.out || next.in) {
				const firstControl = anchor.out ?? anchor.p;
				const secondControl = next.in ?? next.p;
				parts.push(
					`C ${formatNumber(firstControl.x)} ${formatNumber(firstControl.y)} ${formatNumber(secondControl.x)} ${formatNumber(secondControl.y)} ${formatNumber(next.p.x)} ${formatNumber(next.p.y)}`,
				);
			} else {
				parts.push(`L ${formatNumber(next.p.x)} ${formatNumber(next.p.y)}`);
			}
		}

		if (closed[index]) parts.push("Z");
	}

	return parts.join(" ");
}

export interface Vec {
	x: number;
	y: number;
}

export interface Anchor {
	p: Vec;
	out: Vec | null;
	in: Vec | null;
}

export interface VectorPath {
	anchors: Anchor[];
	starts: number[];
	closed: boolean[];
}

export const v = (x: number, y: number): Vec => ({ x, y });
export const add = (a: Vec, b: Vec): Vec => ({
	x: a.x + b.x,
	y: a.y + b.y,
});
export const sub = (a: Vec, b: Vec): Vec => ({
	x: a.x - b.x,
	y: a.y - b.y,
});

export function subRange(path: VectorPath, index: number): [number, number] {
	return [
		path.starts[index],
		index + 1 < path.starts.length
			? path.starts[index + 1]
			: path.anchors.length,
	];
}

number-stepper.name: number-stepper
number-stepper.title: Number Stepper
number-stepper.description: A quantity field whose digits roll the way you count, with a click per step, hold-to-accelerate, and a soft wall at the limits.

"use client";

import NumberFlow, { type Format } from "@number-flow/react";
import { useTiks } from "@rexa-developer/tiks/react";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Minus, Plus } from "lucide-react";
import { animate, motion, useAnimate, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react";
import {
	type ClipboardEvent,
	type KeyboardEvent,
	type MouseEvent,
	type PointerEvent,
	useEffect,
	useId,
	useLayoutEffect,
	useMemo,
	useRef,
	useState,
} from "react";
import { useWebHaptics } from "web-haptics/react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const digitTiming = {
	duration: 450,
	easing: "cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)",
} as const;
const pressSpring = { type: "spring", stiffness: 600, damping: 30 } as const;

/** Ms a press is held before it starts repeating. */
const REPEAT_DELAY = 400;
/** Ms between repeats when repeating starts. */
const REPEAT_SLOW = 120;
/** Fastest ms between repeats. */
const REPEAT_FAST = 40;
/** Ms into a hold at which repeats reach `REPEAT_FAST`. */
const REPEAT_RAMP_END = 1500;
/** Repeats before each step becomes `largeStep` steps. */
const ACCELERATE_AFTER = 10;
/** Minimum ms between step sounds and haptics. */
const CUE_THROTTLE_MS = 35;
/** Ms of quiet before the live region announces the value. */
const ANNOUNCE_DELAY = 300;
/** Trackpad travel, in px, per wheel step. */
const WHEEL_STEP_PX = 50;

const sizes = {
	sm: {
		root: "min-h-8 text-sm",
		button: { outline: "size-6", pill: "size-6", ghost: "size-8" },
		verticalButton: "h-6",
		icon: "[&_svg]:size-3.5",
	},
	md: {
		root: "min-h-9 text-base",
		button: { outline: "size-7", pill: "size-8", ghost: "size-9" },
		verticalButton: "h-7",
		icon: "[&_svg]:size-4",
	},
	lg: {
		root: "min-h-11 text-xl",
		button: { outline: "size-9", pill: "size-10", ghost: "size-11" },
		verticalButton: "h-9",
		icon: "[&_svg]:size-5",
	},
} as const;

const variants = {
	outline: {
		root: "rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent shadow-xs transition-[color,box-shadow] has-[input:focus-visible]:border-ring has-[input:focus-visible]:ring-3 has-[input:focus-visible]:ring-ring/50 data-invalid:border-destructive data-invalid:ring-3 data-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-input/30 dark:data-invalid:ring-destructive/40",
		button:
			"rounded-[calc(var(--radius)-5px)] text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground dark:hover:bg-input/50",
		input: "",
	},
	pill: {
		root: "rounded-full border border-input bg-background p-1 shadow-xs transition-[color,box-shadow] has-[input:focus-visible]:ring-3 has-[input:focus-visible]:ring-ring/50 data-invalid:border-destructive data-invalid:ring-3 data-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-input/30 dark:data-invalid:ring-destructive/40",
		button:
			"rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-xs hover:bg-primary/85",
		input: "",
	},
	ghost: {
		root: "rounded-md",
		button:
			"rounded-md text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground",
		input: "rounded-sm focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50",
	},
} as const;

type Direction = 1 | -1;
type StepKind = "step" | "accelerate";
type StepResult = "moved" | "limit" | "blocked";

export interface NumberStepperProps {
	/** Controlled value. */
	value?: number;
	/** Initial value when uncontrolled. */
	defaultValue?: number;
	/** Called on every step, typed commit, and key press. */
	onValueChange?: (value: number) => void;
	/** Called when a press is released, a typed value commits, or a key steps. */
	onValueCommit?: (value: number) => void;
	min?: number;
	max?: number;
	step?: number;
	/** Steps moved by `Shift`+arrows, `PageUp`/`PageDown`, and accelerated holds. */
	largeStep?: number;
	/** After 10 repeats, a held button moves `largeStep` steps at a time. */
	accelerate?: boolean;
	/** `Intl.NumberFormat` options for the value, e.g. currency or percent. */
	format?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions;
	/** Locale for formatting and parsing typed or pasted values. */
	locale?: string;
	/** Let the wheel change the value while the input is focused. */
	wheel?: boolean;
	size?: keyof typeof sizes;
	variant?: keyof typeof variants;
	/** `vertical` puts increase above the value and decrease below it. */
	orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical";
	/** Play a click per step and a pop at the limits. */
	sound?: boolean;
	/** Trigger haptics on supported devices. */
	haptics?: boolean;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readOnly?: boolean;
	/** Submits the value with a native form through a hidden input. */
	name?: string;
	/** Accessible name for the input; the buttons read "Increase {label}". */
	label?: string;
	className?: string;
}

function decimalsOf(value: number) {
	if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return 0;
	const text = String(value);
	if (text.includes("e-")) return Number(text.split("e-")[1]);
	return text.split(".")[1]?.length ?? 0;
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number) {
	return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
}

type Separators = { group: string; decimal: string };

function getSeparators(locale?: string): Separators {
	const parts = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).formatToParts(12345.6);
	return {
		group: parts.find((part) => part.type === "group")?.value ?? ",",
		decimal: parts.find((part) => part.type === "decimal")?.value ?? ".",
	};
}

/** Reduces locale text to digits, `-`, and a `.` decimal point. */
function normalizeNumber(text: string, { group, decimal }: Separators) {
	return text
		.replace(/[\s  ]/g, "")
		.split(group)
		.join("")
		.split(decimal)
		.join(".")
		.replace(/[−‒-—]/g, "-")
		.replace(/[^\d.-]/g, "");
}

function parseNumber(text: string, separators: Separators, percent: boolean) {
	const clean = normalizeNumber(text, separators);
	const negative = clean.startsWith("-");
	const [whole = "", ...fraction] = clean.replace(/-/g, "").split(".");
	const digits = fraction.length ? `${whole}.${fraction.join("")}` : whole;
	if (!/\d/.test(digits)) return Number.NaN;
	const parsed = Number(digits) * (negative ? -1 : 1);
	// Percent values are fractions: typing "15" in a percent field means 0.15.
	return percent ? parsed / 100 : parsed;
}

export function NumberStepper({
	value: valueProp,
	defaultValue = 1,
	onValueChange,
	onValueCommit,
	min = 0,
	max = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
	step = 1,
	largeStep = 10,
	accelerate = true,
	format,
	locale,
	wheel = false,
	size = "md",
	variant = "outline",
	orientation = "horizontal",
	sound = true,
	haptics = true,
	disabled = false,
	readOnly = false,
	name,
	label = "Value",
	className,
}: NumberStepperProps) {
	const horizontal = orientation === "horizontal";
	const inactive = disabled || readOnly;
	const percent = format?.style === "percent";

	// Steps are anchored at `min`, and the top limit is the last step below `max`.
	const anchor = Number.isFinite(min) ? min : 0;
	const decimals = Math.max(decimalsOf(step), decimalsOf(anchor));
	const lower = min;
	const upper = Number.isFinite(max)
		? Math.max(anchor + Math.floor((max - anchor) / step + 1e-9) * step, lower)
		: max;

	const snap = (raw: number) => {
		const clamped = clamp(raw, lower, upper);
		if (!Number.isFinite(clamped)) return clamped;
		// The ratio is rounded first so 0.175 / 0.05 counts as 3.5, not 3.4999….
		const steps = Math.round(Number(((clamped - anchor) / step).toFixed(9)));
		const snapped = anchor + steps * step;
		// Round to the step's precision so 0.1 + 0.2 lands on 0.3.
		return Number(clamp(snapped, lower, upper).toFixed(decimals));
	};

	const controlled = valueProp !== undefined;
	const [internalValue, setInternalValue] = useState(() => snap(defaultValue));
	const value = controlled ? snap(valueProp) : internalValue;

	// Digits roll in the direction the value moved.
	const [shown, setShown] = useState({ value, trend: 1 });
	if (shown.value !== value) {
		setShown({ value, trend: value > shown.value ? 1 : -1 });
	}

	const [draft, setDraftState] = useState<string | null>(null);
	const [holding, setHolding] = useState<Direction | null>(null);
	const [announcement, setAnnouncement] = useState("");

	const formatter = useMemo(
		() => new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, format),
		[locale, format],
	);
	const separators = useMemo(() => getSeparators(locale), [locale]);
	const formatValue = (next: number) => formatter.format(next);
	const valueText = formatValue(value);

	const draftValue =
		draft === null ? null : parseNumber(draft, separators, percent);
	const invalid =
		draft !== null &&
		draft.trim() !== "" &&
		draftValue !== null &&
		(Number.isNaN(draftValue) || snap(draftValue) !== draftValue);

	const shouldReduceMotion = useReducedMotion() ?? false;
	const { trigger: haptic } = useWebHaptics();
	const {
		click: playClick,
		pop: playPop,
		toggle: playToggle,
		warning: playWarning,
	} = useTiks({
		// Sound stays on under reduced motion; only movement is reduced.
		respectReducedMotion: false,
	});

	const inputId = useId();
	const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
	const [valueScope, animateValue] = useAnimate<HTMLDivElement>();
	const buttonRefs = useRef<Record<Direction, HTMLButtonElement | null>>({
		1: null,
		[-1]: null,
	});
	const ringRefs = useRef<Record<Direction, HTMLSpanElement | null>>({
		1: null,
		[-1]: null,
	});
	const valueRef = useRef(value);
	const draftRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
	const lastEmittedRef = useRef(value);
	const lastCueAtRef = useRef(Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);
	const announcedRef = useRef(valueText);
	const pressRef = useRef(false);
	const pressedButtonRef = useRef<Direction | null>(null);
	const holdRef = useRef<{
		direction: Direction;
		startedAt: number;
		repeats: number;
		accelerated: boolean;
		timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
	} | null>(null);

	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		valueRef.current = value;
	});

	const setDraft = (next: string | null) => {
		draftRef.current = next;
		setDraftState(next);
	};

	const cue = (kind: StepKind) => {
		const now = performance.now();
		if (now - lastCueAtRef.current < CUE_THROTTLE_MS) return;
		lastCueAtRef.current = now;
		if (kind === "accelerate") {
			if (sound) playToggle(true);
			if (haptics) void haptic("light");
		} else {
			if (sound) playClick();
			if (haptics) void haptic("selection");
		}
	};

	const warn = () => {
		lastCueAtRef.current = performance.now();
		if (sound) playWarning();
		if (haptics) void haptic("warning");
	};

	// The soft wall: a pop, a rigid haptic, and a nudge toward the pressed side.
	const hitWall = (direction: Direction) => {
		lastCueAtRef.current = performance.now();
		if (sound) playPop();
		if (haptics) void haptic("rigid");
		if (shouldReduceMotion || !valueScope.current) return;
		const offsets = [0, 4, -3, 0].map(
			(offset) => offset * (horizontal ? direction : -direction),
		);
		void animateValue(
			valueScope.current,
			horizontal ? { x: offsets } : { y: offsets },
			{ duration: 0.22, ease: "easeOut" },
		);
	};

	const emit = (next: number) => {
		valueRef.current = next;
		lastEmittedRef.current = next;
		if (!controlled) setInternalValue(next);
		onValueChange?.(next);
	};

	/** Resolves a pending typed value and returns the value to build on. */
	const commitDraft = () => {
		const text = draftRef.current;
		const current = valueRef.current;
		if (text === null) return current;
		setDraft(null);
		// An emptied field goes back to the last valid value.
		if (text.trim() === "") return current;
		const parsed = parseNumber(text, separators, percent);
		if (Number.isNaN(parsed)) {
			warn();
			return current;
		}
		const next = snap(parsed);
		if (next !== parsed) warn();
		if (next !== current) {
			emit(next);
			onValueCommit?.(next);
		}
		return next;
	};

	const stepBy = (
		direction: Direction,
		multiplier = 1,
		kind: StepKind = "step",
	): StepResult => {
		const current = commitDraft();
		const next = snap(current + direction * step * multiplier);
		if (next === current) return "blocked";
		emit(next);
		const atLimit = direction > 0 ? next >= upper : next <= lower;
		if (atLimit) {
			hitWall(direction);
			return "limit";
		}
		cue(kind);
		return "moved";
	};

	const jumpTo = (target: number) => {
		const current = commitDraft();
		const next = snap(target);
		if (!Number.isFinite(next) || next === current) return;
		emit(next);
		hitWall(next > current ? 1 : -1);
		onValueCommit?.(next);
	};

	const setRing = (
		direction: Direction,
		opacity: number | number[],
		ms = 150,
	) => {
		const ring = ringRefs.current[direction];
		if (ring)
			animate(ring, { opacity }, { duration: ms / 1000, ease: "easeOut" });
	};

	// Scale is driven here rather than with `whileTap`: a button that reaches
	// its limit turns disabled mid-press and would never see the release.
	const pressButton = (direction: Direction) => {
		pressedButtonRef.current = direction;
		const button = buttonRefs.current[direction];
		if (button) animate(button, { scale: 0.92 }, pressSpring);
	};

	const releaseButton = () => {
		const direction = pressedButtonRef.current;
		if (direction === null) return;
		pressedButtonRef.current = null;
		const button = buttonRefs.current[direction];
		if (button) animate(button, { scale: 1 }, pressSpring);
	};

	const endPress = () => {
		releaseButton();
		const hold = holdRef.current;
		if (hold) {
			clearTimeout(hold.timer);
			setRing(hold.direction, 0);
			holdRef.current = null;
			setHolding(null);
		}
		if (pressRef.current) {
			pressRef.current = false;
			onValueCommit?.(valueRef.current);
		}
	};

	const repeat = () => {
		const hold = holdRef.current;
		if (!hold) return;
		hold.repeats += 1;
		const accelerated = accelerate && hold.repeats > ACCELERATE_AFTER;
		const kind = accelerated && !hold.accelerated ? "accelerate" : "step";
		hold.accelerated = accelerated;
		if (hold.repeats === 1) setHolding(hold.direction);
		const result = stepBy(hold.direction, accelerated ? largeStep : 1, kind);
		if (result !== "moved") {
			endPress();
			return;
		}
		const elapsed = performance.now() - hold.startedAt;
		const ramp = clamp(
			(elapsed - REPEAT_DELAY) / (REPEAT_RAMP_END - REPEAT_DELAY),
			0,
			1,
		);
		const interval = REPEAT_SLOW - (REPEAT_SLOW - REPEAT_FAST) * ramp;
		// The ring flashes on each repeat, so its pulse tracks the repeat rate.
		setRing(hold.direction, shouldReduceMotion ? 0.6 : [0.9, 0.25], interval);
		hold.timer = setTimeout(() => repeatRef.current(), interval);
	};

	// Timers call through refs so they always see the latest props.
	const repeatRef = useRef(repeat);
	const endPressRef = useRef(endPress);
	const wheelStepRef = useRef((steps: number) => {
		void steps;
	});
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		repeatRef.current = repeat;
		endPressRef.current = endPress;
		wheelStepRef.current = (steps: number) => {
			const result = stepBy(steps > 0 ? 1 : -1, Math.abs(steps));
			if (result !== "blocked") onValueCommit?.(valueRef.current);
		};
	});

	const handlePointerDown = (
		direction: Direction,
		event: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>,
	) => {
		if (inactive || event.button !== 0) return;
		// Touch captures the pointer implicitly; release it so sliding off cancels.
		if (event.currentTarget.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
			event.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
		}
		endPress();
		pressRef.current = true;
		pressButton(direction);
		if (stepBy(direction) !== "moved") return;
		holdRef.current = {
			direction,
			startedAt: performance.now(),
			repeats: 0,
			accelerated: false,
			timer: setTimeout(() => repeatRef.current(), REPEAT_DELAY),
		};
	};

	// Keyboard and assistive tech activate the buttons with a click of detail 0.
	const handleClick = (
		direction: Direction,
		event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>,
	) => {
		if (inactive || event.detail !== 0) return;
		if (stepBy(direction) !== "blocked") onValueCommit?.(valueRef.current);
	};

	const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
		if (event.key === "Escape" && draftRef.current !== null) {
			event.preventDefault();
			setDraft(null);
			return;
		}
		if (event.key === "Enter") {
			if (draftRef.current === null) return;
			event.preventDefault();
			commitDraft();
			return;
		}
		if (inactive) return;
		let direction: Direction | null = null;
		let multiplier = 1;
		switch (event.key) {
			case "ArrowUp":
				direction = 1;
				multiplier = event.shiftKey ? largeStep : 1;
				break;
			case "ArrowDown":
				direction = -1;
				multiplier = event.shiftKey ? largeStep : 1;
				break;
			case "PageUp":
				direction = 1;
				multiplier = largeStep;
				break;
			case "PageDown":
				direction = -1;
				multiplier = largeStep;
				break;
			case "Home":
				if (!Number.isFinite(lower)) return;
				event.preventDefault();
				jumpTo(lower);
				return;
			case "End":
				if (!Number.isFinite(upper)) return;
				event.preventDefault();
				jumpTo(upper);
				return;
			default:
				return;
		}
		event.preventDefault();
		if (stepBy(direction, multiplier) !== "blocked") {
			onValueCommit?.(valueRef.current);
		}
	};

	const handlePaste = (event: ClipboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
		if (inactive) return;
		event.preventDefault();
		const input = event.currentTarget;
		const pasted = normalizeNumber(
			event.clipboardData.getData("text"),
			separators,
		).replace(".", separators.decimal);
		const text = input.value;
		const start = input.selectionStart ?? text.length;
		const end = input.selectionEnd ?? text.length;
		setDraft(text.slice(0, start) + pasted + text.slice(end));
	};

	// A controlled value that changes mid-hold stops the repeat.
	useEffect(() => {
		if (holdRef.current && valueProp !== lastEmittedRef.current) {
			endPressRef.current();
		}
	}, [valueProp]);

	useEffect(() => {
		if (inactive) endPressRef.current();
	}, [inactive]);

	// Releasing outside the window never reaches the button.
	useEffect(() => {
		if (holding === null) return;
		const end = () => endPressRef.current();
		window.addEventListener("blur", end);
		return () => window.removeEventListener("blur", end);
	}, [holding]);

	useEffect(
		() => () => {
			if (holdRef.current) clearTimeout(holdRef.current.timer);
		},
		[],
	);

	// Announce once the value settles, not on every repeat. A focused
	// spinbutton already reads its own changes, so skip those.
	useEffect(() => {
		if (valueText === announcedRef.current) return;
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			announcedRef.current = valueText;
			if (document.activeElement !== inputRef.current) {
				setAnnouncement(valueText);
			}
		}, ANNOUNCE_DELAY);
		return () => clearTimeout(timer);
	}, [valueText]);

	// Wheel needs a non-passive listener to keep the page from scrolling.
	useEffect(() => {
		const input = inputRef.current;
		if (!input || !wheel || inactive) return;
		let accumulated = 0;
		const onWheel = (event: WheelEvent) => {
			if (document.activeElement !== input || event.deltaY === 0) return;
			event.preventDefault();
			let steps = 0;
			if (event.deltaMode !== 0 || Math.abs(event.deltaY) >= WHEEL_STEP_PX) {
				// One notch, one step.
				steps = -Math.sign(event.deltaY);
				accumulated = 0;
			} else {
				accumulated += event.deltaY;
				steps = -Math.trunc(accumulated / WHEEL_STEP_PX);
				accumulated += steps * WHEEL_STEP_PX;
			}
			if (steps !== 0) wheelStepRef.current(steps);
		};
		input.addEventListener("wheel", onWheel, { passive: false });
		return () => input.removeEventListener("wheel", onWheel);
	}, [wheel, inactive]);

	const atMin = value <= lower;
	const atMax = value >= upper;
	const typing = draft !== null;
	const sizeStyle = sizes[size];
	const variantStyle = variants[variant];
	const widthChars =
		Math.max(
			2,
			...[lower, upper, value]
				.filter(Number.isFinite)
				.map((bound) => formatValue(bound).length),
		) + 1;
	const inputMode =
		lower < 0 ? "text" : decimals > 0 && !percent ? "decimal" : "numeric";

	const renderButton = (direction: Direction) => {
		const increase = direction === 1;
		const blocked = increase ? atMax : atMin;
		const Icon = horizontal
			? increase
				? Plus
				: Minus
			: increase
				? ChevronUp
				: ChevronDown;
		return (
			<button
				ref={(node) => {
					buttonRefs.current[direction] = node;
				}}
				type="button"
				tabIndex={-1}
				aria-label={`${increase ? "Increase" : "Decrease"} ${label}`}
				aria-controls={inputId}
				disabled={inactive || blocked}
				data-slot={`number-stepper-${increase ? "increment" : "decrement"}`}
				data-holding={holding === direction || undefined}
				onPointerDown={(event) => handlePointerDown(direction, event)}
				onPointerUp={endPress}
				onPointerLeave={endPress}
				onPointerCancel={endPress}
				onClick={(event) => handleClick(direction, event)}
				// Keep focus (and any draft) in the input.
				onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
				onContextMenu={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
				className={cn(
					"relative inline-flex pointer-coarse:min-h-11 pointer-coarse:min-w-11 shrink-0 cursor-pointer touch-manipulation select-none items-center justify-center outline-none transition-[opacity,color,background-color] duration-150 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40",
					horizontal
						? sizeStyle.button[variant]
						: cn("w-full", sizeStyle.verticalButton),
					sizeStyle.icon,
					variantStyle.button,
				)}
			>
				<Icon aria-hidden />
				<span
					ref={(node) => {
						ringRefs.current[direction] = node;
					}}
					aria-hidden
					data-slot="number-stepper-ring"
					className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] opacity-0 ring-2 ring-ring ring-offset-1 ring-offset-background"
				/>
			</button>
		);
	};

	return (
		<div
			dir="ltr"
			data-slot="number-stepper"
			data-variant={variant}
			data-size={size}
			data-orientation={orientation}
			data-state={holding !== null ? "holding" : typing ? "typing" : "idle"}
			data-bound={atMin ? "min" : atMax ? "max" : undefined}
			data-invalid={invalid || undefined}
			data-disabled={disabled || undefined}
			data-readonly={readOnly || undefined}
			className={cn(
				"inline-flex w-fit items-center font-medium tabular-nums data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:opacity-50",
				horizontal ? "flex-row gap-1" : "min-w-12 flex-col gap-0.5",
				variant === "outline" && (horizontal ? "px-1" : "py-1"),
				sizeStyle.root,
				variantStyle.root,
				className,
			)}
		>
			{renderButton(horizontal ? -1 : 1)}
			<motion.div
				ref={valueScope}
				data-slot="number-stepper-value"
				className="grid place-items-center"
			>
				<input
					ref={inputRef}
					id={inputId}
					type="text"
					role="spinbutton"
					inputMode={inputMode}
					autoComplete="off"
					autoCorrect="off"
					spellCheck={false}
					aria-label={label}
					aria-valuenow={value}
					aria-valuemin={Number.isFinite(lower) ? lower : undefined}
					aria-valuemax={Number.isFinite(upper) ? upper : undefined}
					aria-valuetext={valueText}
					aria-invalid={invalid || undefined}
					disabled={disabled}
					readOnly={readOnly}
					value={draft ?? valueText}
					onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}
					// Show the real text where the click lands, ready to edit.
					onPointerDown={() => {
						if (!inactive && draftRef.current === null) setDraft(valueText);
					}}
					onBlur={commitDraft}
					onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
					onPaste={handlePaste}
					style={{ width: `${widthChars}ch` }}
					className={cn(
						"col-start-1 row-start-1 h-full min-w-0 bg-transparent px-0.5 text-center outline-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed aria-invalid:text-destructive",
						!horizontal && "py-0.5",
						// While NumberFlow shows the value, the input stays invisible.
						!typing &&
							"text-transparent caret-transparent selection:bg-transparent",
						variantStyle.input,
					)}
				/>
				{typing ? null : (
					<NumberFlow
						aria-hidden
						value={value}
						locales={locale}
						format={format as Format | undefined}
						trend={shown.trend}
						animated={!shouldReduceMotion}
						respectMotionPreference={false}
						transformTiming={digitTiming}
						spinTiming={digitTiming}
						className="pointer-events-none col-start-1 row-start-1"
					/>
				)}
			</motion.div>
			{renderButton(horizontal ? 1 : -1)}
			{name ? (
				<input type="hidden" name={name} value={value} disabled={disabled} />
			) : null}
			<span aria-live="polite" aria-atomic className="sr-only">
				{announcement}
			</span>
		</div>
	);
}

swipe-actions.name: swipe-actions
swipe-actions.title: Swipe Actions
swipe-actions.description: iOS-style list rows you swipe to reveal actions, with threshold haptics, a full-swipe snap, and keyboard support.

files.highlightedContent:
"use client";

import { useTiks } from "@rexa-developer/tiks/react";
import { Ellipsis } from "lucide-react";
import {
	type AnimationPlaybackControls,
	animate,
	LayoutGroup,
	type MotionValue,
	motion,
	useMotionValue,
	useReducedMotion,
	useTransform,
} from "motion/react";
import {
	createContext,
	type FocusEvent,
	type KeyboardEvent,
	type MouseEvent,
	type PointerEvent,
	type ReactNode,
	useCallback,
	useContext,
	useEffect,
	useId,
	useLayoutEffect,
	useMemo,
	useRef,
	useState,
} from "react";
import { useWebHaptics } from "web-haptics/react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const snapSpring = { type: "spring", stiffness: 500, damping: 40 } as const;
const armSpring = { type: "spring", stiffness: 700, damping: 35 } as const;
const collapseTransition = { duration: 0.22, ease: "easeOut" } as const;
const fadeTransition = { duration: 0.12, ease: "easeOut" } as const;
const popTransition = { duration: 0.28, ease: "easeOut" } as const;

/** Pointer travel, in px, before a gesture commits to an axis. */
const AXIS_LOCK = 8;
/** Share of the action group a release must pass to stay open. */
const REVEAL_RATIO = 0.4;
/** Release speed, in px/s, that fires the outermost action. */
const FLICK_VELOCITY = 800;
/** Fastest release, in px/s, so one jumpy pointer event can't fling the row. */
const MAX_VELOCITY = 4000;
/** Seconds of release velocity added when deciding to open or close. */
const PROJECT_SECONDS = 0.08;
/** Resistance past the furthest travel. */
const ELASTIC = 0.1;
/** Distance, in px, a drag must back off a line before it can cross again. */
const HYSTERESIS = 12;
/** Most of the row an action group may cover when revealed. */
const MAX_GROUP_RATIO = 0.75;
/** Minimum gap, in px, between the revealed actions and the arm line. */
const MIN_ARM_GAP = 32;
/** Ms after opening that pointer clicks on actions are ignored, so a double-click on ⋯ can't fire one. */
const OPEN_GUARD_MS = 350;

type Side = "leading" | "trailing";
type RowState =
	| "idle"
	| "dragging"
	| "revealed"
	| "armed"
	| "committing"
	| "collapsed"
	| "disabled";

export type SwipeActionTone = "default" | "blue" | "amber" | "destructive";

export interface SwipeAction {
	id: string;
	/** Visible label and accessible name. */
	label: string;
	icon?: ReactNode;
	tone?: SwipeActionTone;
	/** Collapse the row before calling `onAction`. */
	destructive?: boolean;
	/** Ask "Confirm?" in place before firing. */
	confirm?: boolean;
	/** Live region message once the action fires. Defaults to `label: row label`. */
	announce?: string;
	/** Rejecting springs the row back and plays an error. */
	onAction: () => void | Promise<void>;
}

export interface SwipeActionsProps {
	children: ReactNode;
	/** Revealed by swiping toward the end edge, listed from the start edge in. */
	leading?: SwipeAction[];
	/** Revealed by swiping toward the start edge, listed from the content out. */
	trailing?: SwipeAction[];
	/** Fire the outermost action on a long swipe or a fast flick. */
	fullSwipe?: boolean;
	/** Share of the row width that arms a full swipe. */
	fullSwipeThreshold?: number;
	/** Width of each action, in px. Shrinks to fit narrow rows. */
	actionWidth?: number;
	/** Show a ⋯ button on hover that reveals the actions. */
	showHandle?: boolean;
	/** Show labels under icons. Inherits from `SwipeList`. */
	showLabels?: boolean;
	/** Play a toggle when arming and a swoosh or pop when an action fires. */
	sound?: boolean;
	/** Trigger haptics on supported devices. */
	haptics?: boolean;
	disabled?: boolean;
	/** Accessible name for the row, used in announcements. */
	label: string;
	className?: string;
}

export interface SwipeListProps {
	children: ReactNode;
	/** `inset` rounded cards with a gap, or `plain` edge-to-edge rows. */
	variant?: "inset" | "plain";
	/** Show labels under icons for every row. */
	showLabels?: boolean;
	/** Accessible name for the list. */
	label?: string;
	className?: string;
}

const tones: Record<SwipeActionTone, string> = {
	default: "bg-zinc-500 text-white dark:bg-zinc-600",
	blue: "bg-blue-500 text-white",
	amber: "bg-amber-500 text-white",
	destructive: "bg-red-500 text-white",
};

type SwipeListContextValue = {
	variant: "inset" | "plain";
	showLabels: boolean;
	register: (id: string, close: () => void) => () => void;
	notifyOpen: (id: string) => void;
	announce: (message: string) => void;
};

const SwipeListContext = createContext<SwipeListContextValue | null>(null);

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number) {
	return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
}

/** Polite status region; a counter forces repeat messages to be read again. */
function useAnnouncer() {
	const [message, setMessage] = useState({ text: "", count: 0 });
	const region = (
		<span role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">
			{message.text}
			{message.count % 2 ? "​" : ""}
		</span>
	);
	const announce = useCallback(
		(text: string) =>
			setMessage((previous) => ({ text, count: previous.count + 1 })),
		[],
	);
	return { region, announce };
}

export function SwipeList({
	children,
	variant = "plain",
	showLabels = true,
	label,
	className,
}: SwipeListProps) {
	const rowsRef = useRef(new Map<string, () => void>());
	const { region, announce } = useAnnouncer();

	const value = useMemo<SwipeListContextValue>(
		() => ({
			variant,
			showLabels,
			register: (id, close) => {
				rowsRef.current.set(id, close);
				return () => {
					rowsRef.current.delete(id);
				};
			},
			notifyOpen: (id) => {
				for (const [other, close] of rowsRef.current) {
					if (other !== id) close();
				}
			},
			announce,
		}),
		[variant, showLabels, announce],
	);

	return (
		<SwipeListContext.Provider value={value}>
			<LayoutGroup>
				<div
					role="list"
					aria-label={label}
					data-slot="swipe-list"
					data-variant={variant}
					className={cn("flex flex-col", className)}
				>
					{children}
				</div>
			</LayoutGroup>
			{region}
		</SwipeListContext.Provider>
	);
}

function ActionButton({
	action,
	side,
	count,
	sign,
	x,
	stretch,
	popScale,
	stretchTarget,
	width: actionWidth,
	showLabel,
	reduceMotion,
	confirming,
	onPress,
}: {
	action: SwipeAction;
	side: Side;
	count: number;
	sign: number;
	x: MotionValue<number>;
	stretch: MotionValue<number>;
	popScale: MotionValue<number>;
	stretchTarget: boolean;
	width: number;
	showLabel: boolean;
	reduceMotion: boolean;
	confirming: boolean;
	onPress: (event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void;
}) {
	// Buttons split the revealed width; the stretch target eats the others' share.
	const width = useTransform([x, stretch], ([value, grow]: number[]) => {
		const revealed = Math.max(0, value * sign);
		if (count === 1) return revealed;
		const share = (revealed / count) * (1 - grow);
		return stretchTarget ? revealed - share * (count - 1) : share;
	});
	const progress = useTransform(width, (value) =>
		clamp(value / actionWidth, 0, 1),
	);
	const iconScale = useTransform(progress, (value) =>
		reduceMotion ? 1 : 0.6 + 0.4 * value,
	);
	const opacity = useTransform(progress, (value) => (reduceMotion ? 1 : value));

	return (
		<motion.button
			type="button"
			data-slot="swipe-actions-action"
			data-tone={action.tone ?? "default"}
			data-confirming={confirming || undefined}
			aria-label={confirming ? `Confirm ${action.label}` : undefined}
			onClick={onPress}
			style={{ width }}
			className={cn(
				"relative flex h-full min-w-0 cursor-pointer overflow-hidden outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-white/80 focus-visible:ring-inset",
				side === "leading" ? "justify-end" : "justify-start",
				tones[action.tone ?? "default"],
			)}
		>
			<motion.span
				style={{ width: actionWidth, opacity }}
				className="flex h-full shrink-0 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 px-1"
			>
				{action.icon ? (
					<motion.span
						aria-hidden
						style={{ scale: iconScale }}
						className="flex [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-5"
					>
						<motion.span
							style={{ scale: stretchTarget ? popScale : 1 }}
							className="flex"
						>
							{action.icon}
						</motion.span>
					</motion.span>
				) : null}
				<span
					className={cn(
						"max-w-full truncate font-medium text-xs leading-none",
						!showLabel && !confirming && action.icon && "sr-only",
					)}
				>
					{confirming ? "Confirm?" : action.label}
				</span>
			</motion.span>
		</motion.button>
	);
}

export function SwipeActions({
	children,
	leading = [],
	trailing = [],
	fullSwipe = true,
	fullSwipeThreshold = 0.6,
	actionWidth = 76,
	showHandle = true,
	showLabels: showLabelsProp,
	sound = true,
	haptics = true,
	disabled = false,
	label,
	className,
}: SwipeActionsProps) {
	const list = useContext(SwipeListContext);
	const variant = list?.variant ?? "plain";
	const showLabels = showLabelsProp ?? list?.showLabels ?? true;
	const id = useId();
	const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion() ?? false;
	const { trigger: haptic } = useWebHaptics();
	const {
		toggle: playToggle,
		swoosh: playSwoosh,
		pop: playPop,
		error: playError,
	} = useTiks({
		// Sound stays on under reduced motion; only movement is reduced.
		respectReducedMotion: false,
	});
	const { region, announce: announceLocally } = useAnnouncer();
	const announce = list?.announce ?? announceLocally;

	const collapserRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
	const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
	const x = useMotionValue(0);
	const stretch = useMotionValue(0);
	const popScale = useMotionValue(1);
	const surfaceOpacity = useMotionValue(1);

	const [openSide, setOpenSide] = useState<Side | null>(null);
	const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState<string | null>(null);
	const [rowWidth, setRowWidth] = useState(0);
	const [dir, setDir] = useState(1);

	const openRef = useRef<Side | null>(null);
	const busyRef = useRef(false);
	const suppressClickRef = useRef(false);
	const openedAtRef = useRef(0);
	const xAnimationRef = useRef<AnimationPlaybackControls | null>(null);
	const savedBoxRef = useRef<{
		height: number;
		paddingTop: string;
		paddingBottom: string;
	} | null>(null);
	const cuesRef = useRef({
		side: null as Side | null,
		pastReveal: false,
		armed: false,
	});
	const dragRef = useRef<{
		pointerId: number;
		startX: number;
		startY: number;
		origin: number;
		locked: boolean;
		scale: number;
	} | null>(null);

	const actionsOf = (side: Side) => (side === "leading" ? leading : trailing);
	/** +1 when the side opens by moving content right. Flips in RTL. */
	const signOf = (side: Side) => (side === "leading" ? dir : -dir);
	const sideOf = (value: number): Side | null =>
		value === 0 ? null : value * dir > 0 ? "leading" : "trailing";
	const outermostOf = (side: Side) => {
		const actions = actionsOf(side);
		return side === "leading" ? actions[0] : actions[actions.length - 1];
	};
	const widthOf = (side: Side) => {
		const count = actionsOf(side).length;
		if (!count || !rowWidth) return actionWidth;
		return Math.min(actionWidth, (rowWidth * MAX_GROUP_RATIO) / count);
	};
	const revealOf = (side: Side) => widthOf(side) * actionsOf(side).length;
	const armAtOf = (side: Side) =>
		Math.max(fullSwipeThreshold * rowWidth, revealOf(side) + MIN_ARM_GAP);

	const setRowState = (state: RowState) => {
		if (rootRef.current) rootRef.current.dataset.state = state;
	};

	const moveTo = (target: number, velocity = 0) => {
		xAnimationRef.current?.stop();
		xAnimationRef.current = null;
		if (reduceMotion) {
			if (x.get() === target) return;
			// No travel: the row reappears in place with a short fade.
			x.jump(target);
			surfaceOpacity.jump(0);
			animate(surfaceOpacity, 1, fadeTransition);
			return;
		}
		xAnimationRef.current = animate(x, target, {
			...snapSpring,
			velocity,
			restDelta: 0.5,
		});
	};

	const setStretch = (on: boolean) => {
		if (reduceMotion) stretch.jump(on ? 1 : 0);
		else animate(stretch, on ? 1 : 0, armSpring);
	};

	const pop = () => {
		if (!reduceMotion) animate(popScale, [1, 1.15, 1], popTransition);
	};

	const open = (side: Side, velocity = 0) => {
		openedAtRef.current = performance.now();
		openRef.current = side;
		setOpenSide(side);
		list?.notifyOpen(id);
		setRowState("revealed");
		moveTo(signOf(side) * revealOf(side), velocity);
	};

	const close = (velocity = 0) => {
		openRef.current = null;
		setOpenSide(null);
		setConfirming(null);
		cuesRef.current.armed = false;
		setStretch(false);
		if (!busyRef.current) setRowState("idle");
		moveTo(0, velocity);
	};

	/** Keeps focus out of a tray that is about to go inert. */
	const reclaimFocus = () => {
		const root = rootRef.current;
		if (
			root?.contains(document.activeElement) &&
			document.activeElement !== root
		)
			root.focus({ preventScroll: true });
	};

	const collapse = async () => {
		const element = collapserRef.current;
		if (!element) return;
		const style = getComputedStyle(element);
		savedBoxRef.current = {
			height: element.offsetHeight,
			paddingTop: style.paddingTop,
			paddingBottom: style.paddingBottom,
		};
		if (reduceMotion) {
			await animate(element, { opacity: 0 }, fadeTransition);
			Object.assign(element.style, {
				height: "0px",
				paddingTop: "0px",
				paddingBottom: "0px",
			});
			return;
		}
		await animate(
			element,
			{
				height: [savedBoxRef.current.height, 0],
				paddingTop: [savedBoxRef.current.paddingTop, "0px"],
				paddingBottom: [savedBoxRef.current.paddingBottom, "0px"],
				opacity: [1, 0],
			},
			collapseTransition,
		);
	};

	const expand = async () => {
		const element = collapserRef.current;
		const saved = savedBoxRef.current;
		if (!element || !saved) return;
		await animate(
			element,
			{
				height: saved.height,
				paddingTop: saved.paddingTop,
				paddingBottom: saved.paddingBottom,
				opacity: 1,
			},
			reduceMotion ? fadeTransition : collapseTransition,
		);
		for (const property of [
			"height",
			"padding-top",
			"padding-bottom",
			"opacity",
		])
			element.style.removeProperty(property);
		savedBoxRef.current = null;
	};

	const fail = (action: SwipeAction) => {
		if (sound) playError();
		if (haptics) void haptic("error");
		announce(`${action.label} failed: ${label}`);
	};

	/** The next row's root, so focus has somewhere to go when this one leaves. */
	const neighbourRow = () => {
		const item = collapserRef.current?.parentElement;
		const sibling = item?.nextElementSibling ?? item?.previousElementSibling;
		return sibling?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-slot="swipe-actions"]');
	};

	const fire = async (side: Side, action: SwipeAction, velocity = 0) => {
		if (busyRef.current || disabled) return;
		const sign = signOf(side);

		if (action.confirm && confirming !== action.id) {
			// First press asks in place; the action fills the group.
			cuesRef.current.armed = false;
			openedAtRef.current = performance.now();
			setConfirming(action.id);
			openRef.current = side;
			setOpenSide(side);
			list?.notifyOpen(id);
			setRowState("revealed");
			setStretch(true);
			pop();
			if (sound) playToggle(true);
			if (haptics) void haptic("medium");
			moveTo(sign * revealOf(side), velocity);
			return;
		}

		busyRef.current = true;
		setRowState("committing");
		if (action.destructive) {
			if (sound) playPop();
			if (haptics) void haptic("rigid");
		} else {
			if (sound) playSwoosh();
			if (haptics) void haptic("success");
		}
		announce(action.announce ?? `${action.label}: ${label}`);

		if (!action.destructive) {
			reclaimFocus();
			busyRef.current = false;
			close(velocity);
			setRowState("committing");
			try {
				await action.onAction();
			} catch {
				fail(action);
			} finally {
				if (!openRef.current && !dragRef.current) setRowState("idle");
			}
			return;
		}

		const hadFocus = rootRef.current?.contains(document.activeElement);
		openRef.current = null;
		setOpenSide(null);
		setConfirming(null);
		if (!reduceMotion) {
			xAnimationRef.current?.stop();
			xAnimationRef.current = animate(x, sign * rowWidth, {
				...snapSpring,
				velocity,
			});
		}
		await collapse();
		setRowState("collapsed");
		if (hadFocus)
			(neighbourRow() ?? rootRef.current)?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
		try {
			await action.onAction();
		} catch {
			fail(action);
			xAnimationRef.current?.stop();
			x.jump(0);
			cuesRef.current.armed = false;
			stretch.jump(0);
			await expand();
			busyRef.current = false;
			setRowState("idle");
		}
	};

	// Latest handlers for the imperative listeners, so they never re-bind.
	const api = useRef({ close, track: (_value: number) => {} });
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		api.current = {
			close,
			// Threshold cues, only while a finger or mouse drives the row.
			track: (value) => {
				if (!dragRef.current?.locked) return;
				const cues = cuesRef.current;
				const side = sideOf(value);
				if (side !== cues.side) {
					cues.side = side;
					cues.pastReveal = false;
				}
				if (!side) return;
				const distance = Math.abs(value);
				const revealLine = revealOf(side) * REVEAL_RATIO;
				if (!cues.pastReveal && distance >= revealLine) {
					cues.pastReveal = true;
					if (haptics) void haptic("selection");
				} else if (cues.pastReveal && distance < revealLine - HYSTERESIS) {
					cues.pastReveal = false;
				}
				if (!fullSwipe) return;
				const armAt = armAtOf(side);
				if (!cues.armed && distance >= armAt) {
					cues.armed = true;
					setRowState("armed");
					if (sound) playToggle(true);
					if (haptics) void haptic("medium");
					if (!reduceMotion) {
						animate(stretch, 1, armSpring);
						pop();
					}
				} else if (cues.armed && distance < armAt - HYSTERESIS) {
					cues.armed = false;
					setRowState("dragging");
					if (sound) playToggle(false);
					if (haptics) void haptic("soft");
					if (!reduceMotion) animate(stretch, 0, armSpring);
				}
			},
		};
	});

	useEffect(() => x.on("change", (value) => api.current.track(value)), [x]);

	useEffect(() => {
		if (!list) return;
		return list.register(id, () => {
			if (openRef.current) api.current.close();
		});
	}, [list, id]);

	// Row size and direction.
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		const root = rootRef.current;
		if (!root) return;
		const measure = () => {
			setDir(getComputedStyle(root).direction === "rtl" ? -1 : 1);
			setRowWidth(root.offsetWidth);
		};
		measure();
		const observer = new ResizeObserver(measure);
		observer.observe(root);
		return () => observer.disconnect();
	}, []);

	// A resize while open keeps the actions fully revealed.
	// biome-ignore lint/correctness/useExhaustiveDependencies: only re-anchor on resize
	useEffect(() => {
		const side = openRef.current;
		if (!side || dragRef.current || busyRef.current) return;
		xAnimationRef.current?.stop();
		x.jump(signOf(side) * revealOf(side));
	}, [rowWidth, dir]);

	// Tapping elsewhere or scrolling closes an open row.
	useEffect(() => {
		if (!openSide) return;
		const onPointerDown = (event: globalThis.PointerEvent) => {
			if (!rootRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) api.current.close();
		};
		const onScroll = (event: Event) => {
			if (dragRef.current?.locked) return;
			if (rootRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) return;
			api.current.close();
		};
		document.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown, true);
		window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, true);
		return () => {
			document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown, true);
			window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll, true);
		};
	}, [openSide]);

	// iOS can still scroll the page under a captured pointer; block it mid-drag.
	useEffect(() => {
		const root = rootRef.current;
		if (!root) return;
		const onTouchMove = (event: TouchEvent) => {
			if (dragRef.current?.locked) event.preventDefault();
		};
		root.addEventListener("touchmove", onTouchMove, { passive: false });
		return () => root.removeEventListener("touchmove", onTouchMove);
	}, []);

	useEffect(() => () => xAnimationRef.current?.stop(), []);

	/** Follows the pointer, with resistance past the furthest travel. */
	const resist = (raw: number) => {
		const side = sideOf(raw);
		if (!side || !actionsOf(side).length) return 0;
		const sign = signOf(side);
		const distance = raw * sign;
		const max = fullSwipe ? rowWidth : revealOf(side);
		if (distance <= max) return raw;
		return sign * (reduceMotion ? max : max + (distance - max) * ELASTIC);
	};

	const release = () => {
		const value = x.get();
		const side = sideOf(value);
		const velocity = clamp(x.getVelocity(), -MAX_VELOCITY, MAX_VELOCITY);
		if (!side) return close(velocity);
		const sign = signOf(side);
		const distance = value * sign;
		const speed = velocity * sign;
		const reveal = revealOf(side);
		const outermost = outermostOf(side);
		if (
			fullSwipe &&
			outermost &&
			(cuesRef.current.armed || (speed > FLICK_VELOCITY && distance >= reveal))
		) {
			// A flick skips the arm line, so stretch the outermost action here.
			if (!cuesRef.current.armed && !reduceMotion)
				animate(stretch, 1, armSpring);
			void fire(side, outermost, velocity);
			return;
		}
		const projected = distance + speed * PROJECT_SECONDS;
		if (projected >= reveal * REVEAL_RATIO) open(side, velocity);
		else close(velocity);
	};

	const handlePointerDown = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		if (disabled || busyRef.current || event.button !== 0 || !event.isPrimary)
			return;
		const root = event.currentTarget;
		const rect = root.getBoundingClientRect();
		dragRef.current = {
			pointerId: event.pointerId,
			startX: event.clientX,
			startY: event.clientY,
			origin: x.get(),
			locked: false,
			// CSS zoom and transforms scale client coordinates; work in local px.
			scale: rect.width / (root.offsetWidth || 1) || 1,
		};
	};

	const handlePointerMove = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		const drag = dragRef.current;
		if (!drag || drag.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
		const dx = (event.clientX - drag.startX) / drag.scale;
		if (!drag.locked) {
			const dy = (event.clientY - drag.startY) / drag.scale;
			if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) < AXIS_LOCK) return;
			if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx)) {
				// Vertical: leave the gesture to the page.
				dragRef.current = null;
				return;
			}
			const root = event.currentTarget;
			root.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
			root.dataset.dragging = "";
			xAnimationRef.current?.stop();
			xAnimationRef.current = null;
			drag.locked = true;
			// Count travel from the lock line so a fast first move isn't lost.
			drag.startX += Math.sign(dx) * AXIS_LOCK * drag.scale;
			drag.origin = x.get();
			const side = sideOf(drag.origin);
			cuesRef.current = {
				side,
				pastReveal: side
					? Math.abs(drag.origin) >= revealOf(side) * REVEAL_RATIO
					: false,
				armed: false,
			};
			if (confirming) {
				setConfirming(null);
				setStretch(false);
			}
			setRowState("dragging");
		}
		x.set(resist(drag.origin + (event.clientX - drag.startX) / drag.scale));
	};

	const endDrag = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		const drag = dragRef.current;
		if (!drag || drag.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
		dragRef.current = null;
		if (!drag.locked) return;
		const root = event.currentTarget;
		if (root.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId))
			root.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
		delete root.dataset.dragging;
		// The click that follows a drag belongs to the drag.
		suppressClickRef.current = true;
		setTimeout(() => {
			suppressClickRef.current = false;
		}, 0);
		release();
	};

	const handleClickCapture = (event: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		if (!suppressClickRef.current) return;
		suppressClickRef.current = false;
		event.preventDefault();
		event.stopPropagation();
	};

	// A tap on the content of an open row closes it instead of activating it.
	const handleContentClickCapture = (event: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		if (!openRef.current || event.detail === 0) return;
		event.preventDefault();
		event.stopPropagation();
		close();
	};

	const sideFor = (push: number): Side =>
		push * dir > 0 ? "leading" : "trailing";
	const handleSide: Side | null = trailing.length
		? "trailing"
		: leading.length
			? "leading"
			: null;

	const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		if (disabled || busyRef.current) return;
		const root = event.currentTarget;
		const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
		if (event.key === "Escape" && openRef.current) {
			event.preventDefault();
			close();
			root.focus({ preventScroll: true });
			return;
		}
		const fromRow = target === root;
		const fromTray = !!target.closest('[data-slot="swipe-actions-tray"]');
		if (!fromRow && !fromTray) return;

		if (event.key === "ArrowRight" || event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
			const push = event.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : -1;
			const current = openRef.current;
			if (current) {
				if (signOf(current) === push) return;
				event.preventDefault();
				close();
				root.focus({ preventScroll: true });
				return;
			}
			const side = sideFor(push);
			if (!actionsOf(side).length) return;
			event.preventDefault();
			open(side);
			return;
		}

		if (event.key === "Delete" || event.key === "Backspace") {
			const candidates = (["trailing", "leading"] as const).flatMap((side) =>
				actionsOf(side).map((action) => ({ side, action })),
			);
			const match =
				candidates.find(
					({ action }) => action.destructive && action.tone === "destructive",
				) ?? candidates.find(({ action }) => action.destructive);
			if (!match) return;
			event.preventDefault();
			void fire(match.side, match.action);
		}
	};

	const handleBlur = (event: FocusEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		const next = event.relatedTarget as Node | null;
		if (next && !event.currentTarget.contains(next) && openRef.current) close();
	};

	const renderTray = (side: Side) => {
		const actions = actionsOf(side);
		if (!actions.length) return null;
		const sign = signOf(side);
		const width = widthOf(side);
		const outermost = outermostOf(side);
		const isOpen = openSide === side;
		return (
			<Tray
				id={`${id}-${side}`}
				side={side}
				sign={sign}
				x={x}
				inert={!isOpen || disabled}
				className={tones[outermost?.tone ?? "default"]}
			>
				{actions.map((action) => (
					<ActionButton
						key={action.id}
						action={action}
						side={side}
						count={actions.length}
						sign={sign}
						x={x}
						stretch={stretch}
						popScale={popScale}
						stretchTarget={
							confirming && isOpen
								? confirming === action.id
								: action === outermost
						}
						width={width}
						showLabel={showLabels}
						reduceMotion={reduceMotion}
						confirming={isOpen && confirming === action.id}
						onPress={(event) => {
							// Keyboard clicks have no detail and are never accidental.
							if (
								event.detail > 0 &&
								performance.now() - openedAtRef.current < OPEN_GUARD_MS
							)
								return;
							void fire(side, action);
						}}
					/>
				))}
			</Tray>
		);
	};

	return (
		<motion.div
			layout={list && !reduceMotion ? "position" : undefined}
			role={list ? "listitem" : undefined}
			data-slot="swipe-actions-item"
			className="group/swipe-item"
		>
			<div
				ref={collapserRef}
				className={cn(
					"overflow-hidden",
					variant === "inset" && "pb-2 group-last/swipe-item:pb-0",
				)}
			>
				<div
					ref={rootRef}
					role="group"
					aria-label={label}
					tabIndex={disabled ? -1 : 0}
					data-slot="swipe-actions"
					data-state={disabled ? "disabled" : "idle"}
					data-variant={variant}
					data-open={openSide ?? undefined}
					data-disabled={disabled || undefined}
					onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
					onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
					onPointerUp={endDrag}
					onPointerCancel={endDrag}
					onClickCapture={handleClickCapture}
					onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
					onBlur={handleBlur}
					className={cn(
						"group/swipe relative isolate touch-pan-y overflow-hidden outline-none focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-ring focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 data-dragging:cursor-grabbing data-dragging:select-none data-disabled:opacity-60",
						variant === "inset"
							? "rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-xs"
							: "border-b bg-background group-last/swipe-item:border-b-0",
						className,
					)}
				>
					<motion.div style={{ opacity: surfaceOpacity }} className="relative">
						{renderTray("leading")}
						{renderTray("trailing")}
						<motion.div
							data-slot="swipe-actions-content"
							onClickCapture={handleContentClickCapture}
							style={{ x }}
							className="relative z-10 bg-inherit will-change-transform"
						>
							{children}
							{showHandle && handleSide && !disabled ? (
								<button
									type="button"
									tabIndex={-1}
									data-slot="swipe-actions-handle"
									aria-expanded={openSide !== null}
									aria-controls={`${id}-${openSide ?? handleSide}`}
									aria-label={
										openSide
											? `Hide actions for ${label}`
											: `Show actions for ${label}`
									}
									onClick={() => (openSide ? close() : open(handleSide))}
									className="absolute end-2 top-1/2 flex size-7 -translate-y-1/2 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full border bg-background text-muted-foreground opacity-0 shadow-xs outline-none transition-[opacity,color] duration-150 hover:text-foreground focus-visible:opacity-100 group-hover/swipe:opacity-100 group-data-dragging/swipe:opacity-0 [@media(hover:none)]:sr-only"
								>
									<Ellipsis aria-hidden className="size-4" />
								</button>
							) : null}
						</motion.div>
					</motion.div>
				</div>
			</div>
			{list ? null : region}
		</motion.div>
	);
}

function Tray({
	id,
	side,
	sign,
	x,
	inert,
	className,
	children,
}: {
	id: string;
	side: Side;
	sign: number;
	x: MotionValue<number>;
	inert: boolean;
	className?: string;
	children: ReactNode;
}) {
	const width = useTransform(x, (value) => Math.max(0, value * sign));
	return (
		<motion.div
			id={id}
			inert={inert}
			data-slot="swipe-actions-tray"
			data-side={side}
			style={{ width }}
			className={cn(
				"absolute inset-y-0 flex overflow-hidden",
				side === "leading" ? "start-0" : "end-0",
				className,
			)}
		>
			{children}
		</motion.div>
	);
}

snap-sheet.title: Snap Sheet
snap-sheet.description: A bottom sheet you drag between snap points, with detent haptics, a rubber band, and flick to close.
