"use client";

import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/dialog";
import { useTiks } from "@rexa-developer/tiks/react";
import { XIcon } from "lucide-react";
import {
	type AnimationPlaybackControls,
	animate,
	type MotionValue,
	motion,
	useMotionValue,
	useReducedMotion,
	useTransform,
} from "motion/react";
import {
	type ComponentProps,
	createContext,
	type KeyboardEvent,
	type MouseEvent,
	type PointerEvent,
	type ReactNode,
	type RefObject,
	useCallback,
	useContext,
	useEffect,
	useLayoutEffect,
	useRef,
	useState,
	useSyncExternalStore,
} from "react";
import { useWebHaptics } from "web-haptics/react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const settleSpring = {
	type: "spring",
	stiffness: 400,
	damping: 40,
	mass: 0.9,
} as const;
const openSpring = { type: "spring", stiffness: 320, damping: 34 } as const;
const reducedTween = {
	type: "tween",
	duration: 0.12,
	ease: "easeOut",
} as const;

/** Seconds of release velocity projected ahead before picking a snap point. */
const PROJECTION_SECONDS = 0.2;
/** Downward release speed, in px/s, that closes the sheet from its lowest snap. */
const DISMISS_VELOCITY = 1000;
/** Fastest release, in px/s, so one jumpy pointer event can't fling the sheet. */
const MAX_VELOCITY = 4000;
/** Share of the pointer's travel past full height that the sheet follows. */
const RUBBER_BAND = 0.3;
/** Px past full height where the rubber band hits its limit. */
const RUBBER_LIMIT = 16;
/** Px band around a snap point a drag must clear before it counts as crossed. */
const DETENT_HYSTERESIS = 6;
/** Pointer travel, in px, before a press turns into a drag or a scroll. */
const DRAG_SLOP = 4;
/** Px kept free above the sheet at full height. Matches the height classes. */
const TOP_GAP = 24;
/** Px around the floating variant. Matches its inset classes. */
const FLOATING_INSET = 8;
/** Px past the bottom edge a closed sheet rests at, so its shadow is hidden too. */
const CLOSED_OVERSHOOT = 24;
/** Px from a target where a settling sheet counts as landed for its cue. */
const LANDING_DISTANCE = 2;
const BACKGROUND_SCALE = 0.94;
const BACKGROUND_RADIUS = 12;
const BACKGROUND_OFFSET = 10;
/** Off-screen until the first measure, so the sheet never flashes at full height. */
const UNMEASURED_Y = 10_000;
const NO_DRAG_SELECTOR =
	"input, textarea, select, [contenteditable=''], [contenteditable='true'], [data-sheet-no-drag]";
const DEFAULT_SNAP_POINTS: SnapPoint[] = [0.5, 1];

/** A fraction of the viewport height, or a px string such as `"148px"`. */
export type SnapPoint = number | `${number}px`;
type DesktopMode = "bottom" | "dialog" | "sheet";
type Phase =
	| "closed"
	| "opening"
	| "open"
	| "dragging"
	| "settling"
	| "closing";
type CloseCue = "flick" | "plain" | null;
type Layout = {
	/** `y` of each snap point; 0 is full height. */
	snaps: number[];
	/** `y` with the sheet fully off-screen. */
	closed: number;
	/** Height of the sheet element. */
	max: number;
};
type Drag = {
	pointerId: number;
	startX: number;
	startY: number;
	startSheetY: number;
	scale: number;
	scroller: HTMLElement | null;
	decided: "sheet" | "none" | null;
	fromLowest: boolean;
	hitLimit: boolean;
	sides: number[];
};

export interface SnapSheetProps {
	/** Controlled open state. */
	open?: boolean;
	/** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
	defaultOpen?: boolean;
	onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
	/**
	 * Heights the sheet rests at, lowest first. Numbers are fractions of the
	 * viewport height and px strings are fixed heights. `1` is as tall as the
	 * sheet gets: the viewport less a 24 px gap.
	 */
	snapPoints?: SnapPoint[];
	/** Controlled index into `snapPoints`. */
	activeSnap?: number;
	/** Snap point the sheet opens to when uncontrolled. */
	defaultSnap?: number;
	/** Called when a drag, key press, or handle tap picks a new snap point. */
	onSnapChange?: (index: number) => void;
	/**
	 * Dim the page, trap focus, and lock scroll. Turn it off for map- or
	 * player-style sheets that leave the page interactive.
	 */
	modal?: boolean;
	/** Let a downward drag, a flick, Esc, or an overlay click close the sheet. */
	dismissible?: boolean;
	/** Scale `[data-sheet-wrapper]` back as the sheet reaches full height. */
	scaleBackground?: boolean;
	/** How the sheet renders from the `md` breakpoint up. */
	desktop?: DesktopMode;
	/** Only start drags from `SnapSheet.Handle`. */
	handleOnly?: boolean;
	/** Play a click per snap, a pop at full height, and a swoosh on open and dismiss. */
	sound?: boolean;
	/** Trigger haptics on supported devices. */
	haptics?: boolean;
	/** Play cues for open and snap changes that come from props too. */
	soundOnProgrammatic?: boolean;
	children?: ReactNode;
}

type SnapSheetContextValue = {
	y: MotionValue<number>;
	overlayOpacity: MotionValue<number>;
	dialogScale: MotionValue<number>;
	progress: MotionValue<number>;
	sheetX: MotionValue<string>;
	mode: DesktopMode;
	modal: boolean;
	snapIndex: number;
	snapCount: number;
	snapLabel: string;
	announcement: string;
	setPopup: (node: HTMLDivElement | null) => void;
	containerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
	floatingRef: RefObject<boolean>;
	shouldMoveFocus: () => boolean;
	stepSnap: (index: number) => void;
	handlePointerDown: (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
	consumeClick: () => boolean;
};

const SnapSheetContext = createContext<SnapSheetContextValue | null>(null);

function useSnapSheet() {
	const context = useContext(SnapSheetContext);
	if (!context) {
		throw new Error("SnapSheet parts must be rendered inside <SnapSheet>.");
	}
	return context;
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number) {
	return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
}

function toPx(point: SnapPoint, frame: number) {
	return typeof point === "number" ? point * frame : Number.parseFloat(point);
}

function describeSnap(points: SnapPoint[], index: number) {
	const point = points[index];
	const last = index === points.length - 1;
	if (typeof point === "number") {
		if (last && point >= 0.85) return "Full height";
		if (Math.abs(point - 0.5) < 0.05) return "Half height";
		if (index === 0) return "Peek height";
		return `${Math.round(point * 100)}% height`;
	}
	if (index === 0) return "Peek height";
	if (last) return "Full height";
	return `Height ${index + 1} of ${points.length}`;
}

/** Which side of `snap` a sheet at `y` sits on: -1 above, 1 below, 0 inside the band. */
function sideOf(y: number, snap: number) {
	if (y < snap - DETENT_HYSTERESIS / 2) return -1;
	if (y > snap + DETENT_HYSTERESIS / 2) return 1;
	return 0;
}

/** The nearest element between `target` and `sheet` that scrolls vertically. */
function findScroller(target: Element, sheet: HTMLElement) {
	let node: Element | null = target;
	while (node && node !== sheet) {
		if (node instanceof HTMLElement && node.scrollHeight > node.clientHeight) {
			const { overflowY } = getComputedStyle(node);
			if (overflowY === "auto" || overflowY === "scroll") return node;
		}
		node = node.parentElement;
	}
	return null;
}

function resolveContainer(
	container: HTMLElement | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | null | undefined,
) {
	if (!container) return null;
	return container instanceof HTMLElement ? container : container.current;
}

function subscribeDesktop(onChange: () => void) {
	const query = window.matchMedia("(min-width: 768px)");
	query.addEventListener("change", onChange);
	return () => query.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
}

function useIsDesktop() {
	return useSyncExternalStore(
		subscribeDesktop,
		() => window.matchMedia("(min-width: 768px)").matches,
		() => false,
	);
}

function SnapSheet({
	open: openProp,
	defaultOpen = false,
	onOpenChange,
	snapPoints = DEFAULT_SNAP_POINTS,
	activeSnap,
	defaultSnap = 0,
	onSnapChange,
	modal = true,
	dismissible = true,
	scaleBackground = false,
	desktop = "bottom",
	handleOnly = false,
	sound = true,
	haptics = true,
	soundOnProgrammatic = false,
	children,
}: SnapSheetProps) {
	const snapCount = Math.max(1, snapPoints.length);
	const [uncontrolledOpen, setUncontrolledOpen] = useState(defaultOpen);
	const open = openProp ?? uncontrolledOpen;
	// Stays mounted through the close animation, then unmounts.
	const [rendered, setRendered] = useState(open);
	if (open && !rendered) setRendered(true);

	const [uncontrolledSnap, setUncontrolledSnap] = useState(defaultSnap);
	const snapIndex = clamp(activeSnap ?? uncontrolledSnap, 0, snapCount - 1);
	const [announcement, setAnnouncement] = useState("");
	const [popup, setPopupState] = useState<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

	const isDesktop = useIsDesktop();
	const mode: DesktopMode = isDesktop ? desktop : "bottom";
	const shouldReduceMotion = useReducedMotion() ?? false;
	const { trigger: haptic } = useWebHaptics();
	const {
		click: playClick,
		pop: playPop,
		swoosh: playSwoosh,
	} = useTiks({
		// Sound stays on under reduced motion; only movement is reduced.
		respectReducedMotion: false,
	});

	const y = useMotionValue(UNMEASURED_Y);
	const progress = useMotionValue(0);
	const popupRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
	const containerRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
	const floatingRef = useRef(false);
	const wrapperRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
	const directionRef = useRef(1);
	const phaseRef = useRef<Phase>("closed");
	const layoutRef = useRef<Layout | null>(null);
	const animationRef = useRef<AnimationPlaybackControls | null>(null);
	const dragRef = useRef<Drag | null>(null);
	/** Snap index the sheet rests at or is heading to. */
	const indexRef = useRef(snapIndex);
	/** Snap index the sheet last came to rest at, for "settled somewhere new". */
	const settledIndexRef = useRef(snapIndex);
	const landingRef = useRef<{ y: number; index: number } | null>(null);
	const userOpenRef = useRef(false);
	const suppressClickRef = useRef(false);

	// Latest values for the imperative handlers below, so they never re-bind.
	const latest = useRef({
		open,
		snapPoints,
		snapIndex,
		activeSnap,
		defaultSnap,
		mode,
		modal,
		dismissible,
		scaleBackground,
		handleOnly,
		sound,
		haptics,
		soundOnProgrammatic,
		shouldReduceMotion,
		onOpenChange,
		onSnapChange,
	});
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		latest.current = {
			open,
			snapPoints,
			snapIndex,
			activeSnap,
			defaultSnap,
			mode,
			modal,
			dismissible,
			scaleBackground,
			handleOnly,
			sound,
			haptics,
			soundOnProgrammatic,
			shouldReduceMotion,
			onOpenChange,
			onSnapChange,
		};
	});

	const overlayOpacity = useTransform(() => {
		const value = y.get();
		const amount = progress.get();
		const layout = layoutRef.current;
		if (latest.current.mode !== "bottom") return amount;
		if (!layout) return 0;
		const top = layout.snaps[layout.snaps.length - 1] ?? 0;
		// Modal sheets dim from closed; non-modal ones only near full height.
		const from =
			latest.current.modal || layout.snaps.length < 2
				? layout.closed
				: (layout.snaps[layout.snaps.length - 2] ?? layout.closed);
		return clamp((from - value) / (from - top || 1), 0, 1);
	});
	const dialogScale = useTransform(progress, [0, 1], [0.96, 1]);
	const sheetX = useTransform(
		() => `${(1 - progress.get()) * 100 * directionRef.current}%`,
	);

	const setPhase = useCallback((phase: Phase) => {
		phaseRef.current = phase;
		if (popupRef.current) popupRef.current.dataset.sheetState = phase;
	}, []);

	const setPopup = useCallback((node: HTMLDivElement | null) => {
		popupRef.current = node;
		if (node) node.dataset.sheetState = phaseRef.current;
		setPopupState(node);
	}, []);

	const measure = useCallback(() => {
		const element = popupRef.current;
		if (!element) return null;
		const max = element.offsetHeight;
		const inset = floatingRef.current ? FLOATING_INSET : 0;
		const frame = max + TOP_GAP + inset;
		const snaps = latest.current.snapPoints.map(
			(point) => max - clamp(toPx(point, frame), 0, max),
		);
		if (snaps.length === 0) snaps.push(0);
		layoutRef.current = { snaps, closed: max + inset + CLOSED_OVERSHOOT, max };
		directionRef.current =
			getComputedStyle(element).direction === "rtl" ? -1 : 1;
		return layoutRef.current;
	}, []);

	const stop = useCallback(() => {
		animationRef.current?.stop();
		animationRef.current = null;
	}, []);

	const runTo = useCallback(
		(
			value: MotionValue<number>,
			to: number,
			transition: typeof settleSpring | typeof openSpring,
			velocity: number,
			onComplete: () => void,
		) => {
			stop();
			if (value.get() === to) {
				onComplete();
				return;
			}
			animationRef.current = animate(value, to, {
				...(latest.current.shouldReduceMotion
					? reducedTween
					: { ...transition, velocity }),
				restDelta: 0.5,
				onComplete: () => {
					animationRef.current = null;
					onComplete();
				},
			});
		},
		[stop],
	);

	const playSnapCue = useCallback(
		(index: number) => {
			const { sound, haptics, snapPoints } = latest.current;
			const top = index === snapPoints.length - 1;
			if (sound) (top ? playPop : playClick)();
			if (haptics) void haptic(top ? "light" : "selection");
		},
		[haptic, playClick, playPop],
	);

	const resetWrapper = useCallback(() => {
		const wrapper = wrapperRef.current;
		if (!wrapper) return;
		wrapper.style.removeProperty("transform");
		wrapper.style.removeProperty("transform-origin");
		wrapper.style.removeProperty("border-radius");
		wrapper.style.removeProperty("overflow");
		wrapper.style.removeProperty("will-change");
		wrapperRef.current = null;
	}, []);

	const attachWrapper = useCallback(() => {
		resetWrapper();
		const { scaleBackground, shouldReduceMotion, mode } = latest.current;
		if (!scaleBackground || shouldReduceMotion || mode !== "bottom") return;
		const root = containerRef.current ?? document;
		const wrapper = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>("[data-sheet-wrapper]");
		if (!wrapper) return;
		wrapper.style.transformOrigin = "center top";
		wrapper.style.willChange = "transform";
		wrapperRef.current = wrapper;
	}, [resetWrapper]);

	const animateOpen = useCallback(
		(cue: boolean) => {
			const layout = measure();
			if (!layout) return;
			const fromClosed = phaseRef.current === "closed";
			const index = clamp(latest.current.snapIndex, 0, layout.snaps.length - 1);
			indexRef.current = index;
			settledIndexRef.current = index;
			landingRef.current = null;
			attachWrapper();
			setPhase("opening");
			if (latest.current.mode === "bottom") {
				if (fromClosed) y.jump(layout.closed);
				progress.jump(1);
				runTo(y, layout.snaps[index] ?? 0, openSpring, 0, () =>
					setPhase("open"),
				);
			} else {
				y.jump(0);
				if (fromClosed) progress.jump(0);
				runTo(progress, 1, openSpring, 0, () => setPhase("open"));
			}
			if (cue && latest.current.sound) playSwoosh();
		},
		[attachWrapper, measure, playSwoosh, progress, runTo, setPhase, y],
	);

	const animateClose = useCallback(
		(velocity: number, cue: CloseCue) => {
			const finish = () => {
				setPhase("closed");
				resetWrapper();
				// A controlled parent can refuse to close; come back up.
				if (latest.current.open) {
					animateOpen(false);
					return;
				}
				setRendered(false);
				// Uncontrolled sheets open at their default snap point again.
				if (latest.current.activeSnap === undefined) {
					const index = clamp(
						latest.current.defaultSnap,
						0,
						latest.current.snapPoints.length - 1,
					);
					indexRef.current = index;
					setUncontrolledSnap(index);
				}
			};
			landingRef.current = null;
			setPhase("closing");
			const layout = layoutRef.current;
			if (latest.current.mode === "bottom" && layout) {
				runTo(y, layout.closed, openSpring, velocity, finish);
			} else {
				runTo(progress, 0, openSpring, 0, finish);
			}
			if (cue) {
				if (latest.current.sound) playSwoosh();
				if (cue === "flick" && latest.current.haptics) void haptic("nudge");
			}
		},
		[
			animateOpen,
			haptic,
			playSwoosh,
			progress,
			resetWrapper,
			runTo,
			setPhase,
			y,
		],
	);

	const setOpen = useCallback((next: boolean) => {
		if (latest.current.open === next) return;
		setUncontrolledOpen(next);
		latest.current.onOpenChange?.(next);
	}, []);

	const requestClose = useCallback(
		(cue: CloseCue, velocity = 0) => {
			const phase = phaseRef.current;
			if (phase === "closed" || phase === "closing") return;
			setOpen(false);
			animateClose(velocity, cue);
		},
		[animateClose, setOpen],
	);

	const settle = useCallback(
		(index: number, { velocity = 0, cue = false } = {}) => {
			const layout = layoutRef.current;
			if (!layout) return;
			const target = layout.snaps[index] ?? 0;
			indexRef.current = index;
			landingRef.current =
				cue && index !== settledIndexRef.current ? { y: target, index } : null;
			setPhase("settling");
			runTo(y, target, settleSpring, velocity, () => {
				settledIndexRef.current = index;
				setPhase("open");
				const landing = landingRef.current;
				if (landing) {
					landingRef.current = null;
					playSnapCue(landing.index);
				}
			});
		},
		[playSnapCue, runTo, setPhase, y],
	);

	/** Moves to a snap picked by the user and reports it. */
	const commitSnap = useCallback(
		(index: number, velocity = 0) => {
			settle(index, { velocity, cue: true });
			if (index === latest.current.snapIndex) return;
			setUncontrolledSnap(index);
			setAnnouncement(
				`Sheet at ${describeSnap(latest.current.snapPoints, index).toLowerCase()}`,
			);
			latest.current.onSnapChange?.(index);
		},
		[settle],
	);

	// Open and close from state, whether it changed here or through props.
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		if (!popup) return;
		const phase = phaseRef.current;
		if (open) {
			if (phase === "closed" || phase === "closing") {
				const cue = userOpenRef.current || latest.current.soundOnProgrammatic;
				animateOpen(cue);
			}
			return;
		}
		if (phase === "closed") {
			setRendered(false);
		} else if (phase !== "closing") {
			animateClose(0, latest.current.soundOnProgrammatic ? "plain" : null);
		}
	}, [open, popup, animateOpen, animateClose]);

	// Controlled snap: glide there, unless a drag is in progress (the drag wins).
	useEffect(() => {
		if (activeSnap === undefined) return;
		const phase = phaseRef.current;
		if (phase === "dragging" || phase === "closed" || phase === "closing") {
			return;
		}
		const index = clamp(activeSnap, 0, snapCount - 1);
		if (index === indexRef.current) return;
		settle(index, { cue: latest.current.soundOnProgrammatic });
	}, [activeSnap, snapCount, settle]);

	// The one place that reacts to movement: detents, the rubber band,
	// landing cues, and the background scale.
	useEffect(() => {
		const sync = (value: number) => {
			const layout = layoutRef.current;
			if (!layout) return;
			const { haptics } = latest.current;
			const landing = landingRef.current;
			if (landing && Math.abs(value - landing.y) < LANDING_DISTANCE) {
				landingRef.current = null;
				playSnapCue(landing.index);
			}

			const top = layout.snaps[layout.snaps.length - 1] ?? 0;
			const drag = dragRef.current;
			if (phaseRef.current === "dragging" && drag) {
				if (!drag.hitLimit && value < top - RUBBER_LIMIT) {
					drag.hitLimit = true;
					if (haptics) void haptic("rigid");
				}
				let crossed = false;
				layout.snaps.forEach((snap, index) => {
					const side = sideOf(value, snap);
					if (side === 0 || side === drag.sides[index]) return;
					if (drag.sides[index] !== 0) crossed = true;
					drag.sides[index] = side;
				});
				if (crossed && haptics) void haptic("soft");
			}

			const wrapper = wrapperRef.current;
			if (!wrapper) return;
			const from =
				layout.snaps.length > 1
					? (layout.snaps[layout.snaps.length - 2] ?? layout.closed)
					: layout.closed;
			const amount = clamp((from - value) / (from - top || 1), 0, 1);
			if (amount === 0) {
				wrapper.style.removeProperty("transform");
				wrapper.style.removeProperty("border-radius");
				wrapper.style.removeProperty("overflow");
				return;
			}
			const scale = 1 - (1 - BACKGROUND_SCALE) * amount;
			wrapper.style.transform = `translateY(${BACKGROUND_OFFSET * amount}px) scale(${scale})`;
			wrapper.style.borderRadius = `${BACKGROUND_RADIUS * amount}px`;
			wrapper.style.overflow = "hidden";
		};
		return y.on("change", sync);
	}, [haptic, playSnapCue, y]);

	// Recompute snap px on resize, rotation, and the iOS address bar.
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		if (!popup) return;
		let lastHeight = popup.offsetHeight;
		const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
			if (latest.current.mode !== "bottom") return;
			if (popup.offsetHeight === lastHeight) return;
			lastHeight = popup.offsetHeight;
			const layout = measure();
			if (!layout) return;
			const target = layout.snaps[indexRef.current] ?? 0;
			const phase = phaseRef.current;
			if (phase === "open") {
				y.jump(target);
			} else if (phase === "opening" || phase === "settling") {
				runTo(y, target, settleSpring, y.getVelocity(), () => setPhase("open"));
			}
		});
		observer.observe(popup);
		return () => observer.disconnect();
	}, [popup, measure, runTo, setPhase, y]);

	// Keep the sheet above the virtual keyboard.
	useEffect(() => {
		const viewport = window.visualViewport;
		if (!popup || !viewport || containerRef.current) return;
		const update = () => {
			const keyboard =
				viewport.scale > 1.01
					? 0
					: Math.max(
							0,
							Math.round(
								window.innerHeight - viewport.height - viewport.offsetTop,
							),
						);
			popup.style.setProperty("--snap-sheet-keyboard", `${keyboard}px`);
		};
		update();
		viewport.addEventListener("resize", update);
		viewport.addEventListener("scroll", update);
		return () => {
			viewport.removeEventListener("resize", update);
			viewport.removeEventListener("scroll", update);
		};
	}, [popup]);

	// Switching between bottom and desktop layouts while open.
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		const phase = phaseRef.current;
		if (phase === "closed" || phase === "closing") return;
		stop();
		attachWrapper();
		if (mode === "bottom") {
			const layout = measure();
			progress.jump(1);
			if (layout) y.jump(layout.snaps[indexRef.current] ?? 0);
		} else {
			y.jump(0);
			progress.jump(1);
		}
		setPhase("open");
	}, [mode, attachWrapper, measure, progress, setPhase, stop, y]);

	useEffect(
		() => () => {
			stop();
			resetWrapper();
		},
		[stop, resetWrapper],
	);

	const beginDrag = useCallback(
		(drag: Drag, clientY: number) => {
			const layout = layoutRef.current;
			const sheet = popupRef.current;
			if (!layout || !sheet) return;
			stop();
			landingRef.current = null;
			drag.startY = clientY;
			drag.startSheetY = y.get();
			drag.sides = layout.snaps.map((snap) => sideOf(drag.startSheetY, snap));
			setPhase("dragging");
			try {
				sheet.setPointerCapture(drag.pointerId);
			} catch {
				// The pointer may already be gone.
			}
			window.getSelection()?.removeAllRanges();
			suppressClickRef.current = true;
		},
		[setPhase, stop, y],
	);

	/** Settles on the first move past the slop: the sheet drags or the content scrolls. */
	const decide = useCallback(
		(drag: Drag, clientX: number, clientY: number) => {
			const dx = clientX - drag.startX;
			const dy = clientY - drag.startY;
			if (Math.abs(dx) < DRAG_SLOP && Math.abs(dy) < DRAG_SLOP) return;
			// Axis lock: sideways swipes belong to carousels and the browser.
			if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
				drag.decided = "none";
				return;
			}
			const layout = layoutRef.current;
			const top = layout?.snaps[layout.snaps.length - 1] ?? 0;
			const atFull = y.get() <= top + 1;
			const scroller = drag.scroller;
			const scrolls = scroller && (dy < 0 || scroller.scrollTop > 0);
			drag.decided = atFull && scrolls ? "none" : "sheet";
			if (drag.decided === "sheet") beginDrag(drag, clientY);
		},
		[beginDrag, y],
	);

	const release = useCallback(
		(drag: Drag) => {
			const layout = layoutRef.current;
			if (!layout) return;
			const { dismissible } = latest.current;
			const velocity = clamp(y.getVelocity(), -MAX_VELOCITY, MAX_VELOCITY);
			const current = y.get();
			const lowest = layout.snaps[0] ?? 0;
			if (
				dismissible &&
				velocity > DISMISS_VELOCITY &&
				(drag.fromLowest || current >= lowest)
			) {
				requestClose("flick", velocity);
				return;
			}
			const projected = current + velocity * PROJECTION_SECONDS;
			let nearest = 0;
			layout.snaps.forEach((snap, index) => {
				if (
					Math.abs(snap - projected) <
					Math.abs((layout.snaps[nearest] ?? 0) - projected)
				) {
					nearest = index;
				}
			});
			const nearestDistance = Math.abs(
				(layout.snaps[nearest] ?? 0) - projected,
			);
			if (
				dismissible &&
				Math.abs(layout.closed - projected) < nearestDistance
			) {
				requestClose("flick", Math.max(velocity, 0));
				return;
			}
			commitSnap(nearest, velocity);
		},
		[commitSnap, requestClose, y],
	);

	const handlePointerDown = useCallback(
		(event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
			const { mode, handleOnly } = latest.current;
			if (mode !== "bottom" || !event.isPrimary) return;
			if (event.pointerType === "mouse" && event.button !== 0) return;
			const phase = phaseRef.current;
			if (phase === "closed" || phase === "closing") return;
			const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
			const sheet = event.currentTarget;
			const onHandle = Boolean(
				target.closest("[data-slot='snap-sheet-handle']"),
			);
			if (handleOnly && !onHandle) return;
			if (!onHandle && target.closest(NO_DRAG_SELECTOR)) return;
			const rect = sheet.getBoundingClientRect();
			suppressClickRef.current = false;
			dragRef.current = {
				pointerId: event.pointerId,
				startX: event.clientX,
				startY: event.clientY,
				startSheetY: y.get(),
				// CSS zoom and transforms scale client coordinates; work in local px.
				scale: rect.height / (sheet.offsetHeight || 1) || 1,
				scroller: onHandle ? null : findScroller(target, sheet),
				decided: null,
				fromLowest: settledIndexRef.current === 0,
				hitLimit: false,
				sides: [],
			};
		},
		[y],
	);

	// Follow the gesture on window: before it's decided, the pointer can leave
	// the sheet, and capturing on press would retarget clicks inside it.
	useEffect(() => {
		if (!popup) return;
		const onPointerMove = (event: globalThis.PointerEvent) => {
			const drag = dragRef.current;
			if (!drag || drag.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
			if (drag.decided === null) decide(drag, event.clientX, event.clientY);
			if (drag.decided !== "sheet") return;
			const layout = layoutRef.current;
			if (!layout) return;
			const raw = drag.startSheetY + (event.clientY - drag.startY) / drag.scale;
			const top = layout.snaps[layout.snaps.length - 1] ?? 0;
			const lowest = layout.snaps[0] ?? 0;
			let next = raw;
			if (raw < top) {
				next = top - (top - raw) * RUBBER_BAND;
			} else if (!latest.current.dismissible && raw > lowest) {
				next = lowest + (raw - lowest) * RUBBER_BAND;
			}
			y.set(Math.min(next, layout.closed));
		};
		const onPointerUp = (event: globalThis.PointerEvent) => {
			const drag = dragRef.current;
			if (!drag || drag.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
			dragRef.current = null;
			if (popup.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
				popup.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
			}
			if (drag.decided === "sheet") release(drag);
		};
		window.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
		window.addEventListener("pointerup", onPointerUp);
		window.addEventListener("pointercancel", onPointerUp);
		return () => {
			window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
			window.removeEventListener("pointerup", onPointerUp);
			window.removeEventListener("pointercancel", onPointerUp);
		};
	}, [popup, decide, release, y]);

	// iOS and Android start scrolling unless the first touchmove is cancelled.
	useEffect(() => {
		if (!popup) return;
		const onTouchMove = (event: TouchEvent) => {
			const drag = dragRef.current;
			const touch = event.touches[0];
			if (!drag || !touch) return;
			if (drag.decided === null) decide(drag, touch.clientX, touch.clientY);
			if (drag.decided === "sheet" && event.cancelable) event.preventDefault();
		};
		popup.addEventListener("touchmove", onTouchMove, { passive: false });
		return () => popup.removeEventListener("touchmove", onTouchMove);
	}, [popup, decide]);

	const stepSnap = useCallback(
		(index: number) => {
			const phase = phaseRef.current;
			if (phase === "closed" || phase === "closing" || phase === "dragging") {
				return;
			}
			commitSnap(clamp(index, 0, latest.current.snapPoints.length - 1));
		},
		[commitSnap],
	);

	const consumeClick = useCallback(() => {
		const suppressed = suppressClickRef.current;
		suppressClickRef.current = false;
		return suppressed;
	}, []);

	const shouldMoveFocus = useCallback(
		() => latest.current.modal || userOpenRef.current,
		[],
	);

	const handleOpenChange = useCallback(
		(next: boolean, details: DialogPrimitive.Root.ChangeEventDetails) => {
			if (next) {
				userOpenRef.current = true;
				setOpen(true);
				return;
			}
			const userDismissal =
				details.reason === "escape-key" || details.reason === "outside-press";
			if (userDismissal && !latest.current.dismissible) return;
			requestClose("plain");
		},
		[requestClose, setOpen],
	);

	// Opens that don't come through the trigger stay silent and keep focus.
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		if (!open) userOpenRef.current = false;
	}, [open]);

	return (
		<SnapSheetContext.Provider
			value={{
				y,
				overlayOpacity,
				dialogScale,
				progress,
				sheetX,
				mode,
				modal,
				snapIndex,
				snapCount,
				snapLabel: describeSnap(snapPoints, snapIndex),
				announcement,
				setPopup,
				containerRef,
				floatingRef,
				shouldMoveFocus,
				stepSnap,
				handlePointerDown,
				consumeClick,
			}}
		>
			<DialogPrimitive.Root
				open={rendered}
				onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}
				modal={modal}
				disablePointerDismissal={!modal || !dismissible}
			>
				{children}
			</DialogPrimitive.Root>
		</SnapSheetContext.Provider>
	);
}

function SnapSheetTrigger(props: DialogPrimitive.Trigger.Props) {
	return <DialogPrimitive.Trigger data-slot="snap-sheet-trigger" {...props} />;
}

export interface SnapSheetContentProps {
	className?: string;
	overlayClassName?: string;
	/**
	 * Element to render into instead of `document.body`, such as a phone frame.
	 * Give it `position: relative` and `overflow: clip`.
	 */
	container?: HTMLElement | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | null;
	/** `attached` spans the width with rounded top corners; `floating` is inset and fully rounded. */
	variant?: "attached" | "floating";
	children?: ReactNode;
}

function SnapSheetContent({
	className,
	overlayClassName,
	container,
	variant = "attached",
	children,
}: SnapSheetContentProps) {
	const {
		y,
		overlayOpacity,
		dialogScale,
		progress,
		sheetX,
		mode,
		modal,
		announcement,
		setPopup,
		containerRef,
		floatingRef,
		shouldMoveFocus,
		handlePointerDown,
	} = useSnapSheet();
	const contained = Boolean(container);
	const floating = variant === "floating";

	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		containerRef.current = resolveContainer(container);
		floatingRef.current = floating;
	});

	const style =
		mode === "dialog"
			? { opacity: progress, scale: dialogScale }
			: mode === "sheet"
				? { x: sheetX }
				: { y };

	return (
		<DialogPrimitive.Portal container={container}>
			<DialogPrimitive.Backdrop
				data-slot="snap-sheet-overlay"
				forceRender
				render={<motion.div style={{ opacity: overlayOpacity }} />}
				className={cn(
					"inset-0 z-50 bg-black/40",
					contained ? "absolute" : "fixed",
					!modal && "pointer-events-none",
					overlayClassName,
				)}
			/>
			<DialogPrimitive.Popup
				ref={setPopup}
				data-slot="snap-sheet-content"
				data-mode={mode}
				data-variant={variant}
				aria-modal={modal || undefined}
				initialFocus={shouldMoveFocus}
				render={<motion.div style={style} />}
				onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
				className={cn(
					"group/sheet z-50 flex flex-col overscroll-contain border border-border/70 bg-background text-foreground outline-none",
					contained ? "absolute" : "fixed",
					mode === "bottom" && [
						"touch-none will-change-transform data-[sheet-state=dragging]:select-none",
						"shadow-[0_-12px_40px_-16px_rgb(0_0_0/0.35)]",
						floating
							? "inset-x-2 bottom-2 mx-auto max-w-xl rounded-[28px]"
							: "inset-x-0 bottom-0 mx-auto w-full max-w-xl rounded-t-[22px] border-b-0",
						contained
							? floating
								? "h-[calc(100%-32px)]"
								: "h-[calc(100%-24px)]"
							: floating
								? "mb-[var(--snap-sheet-keyboard,0px)] h-[calc(100dvh-32px-var(--snap-sheet-keyboard,0px))]"
								: "mb-[var(--snap-sheet-keyboard,0px)] h-[calc(100dvh-24px-var(--snap-sheet-keyboard,0px))]",
					],
					mode === "dialog" &&
						"top-1/2 left-1/2 max-h-[calc(100dvh-4rem)] w-[calc(100%-2rem)] max-w-lg -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-2xl pt-4 shadow-2xl",
					mode === "sheet" &&
						"inset-y-0 end-0 w-full max-w-md border-y-0 border-e-0 pt-4 shadow-2xl",
					className,
				)}
			>
				{children}
				<span aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">
					{announcement}
				</span>
			</DialogPrimitive.Popup>
		</DialogPrimitive.Portal>
	);
}

function SnapSheetHandle({
	className,
	onClick,
	onKeyDown,
	...props
}: Omit<ComponentProps<"button">, "children">) {
	const { mode, snapIndex, snapCount, snapLabel, stepSnap, consumeClick } =
		useSnapSheet();
	if (mode !== "bottom") return null;

	const handleClick = (event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
		onClick?.(event);
		if (consumeClick() || event.defaultPrevented) return;
		// Tapping or pressing Enter cycles through the snap points.
		stepSnap((snapIndex + 1) % snapCount);
	};

	const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
		onKeyDown?.(event);
		if (event.defaultPrevented) return;
		const targets: Record<string, number> = {
			ArrowUp: snapIndex + 1,
			ArrowRight: snapIndex + 1,
			ArrowDown: snapIndex - 1,
			ArrowLeft: snapIndex - 1,
			Home: 0,
			End: snapCount - 1,
		};
		const target = targets[event.key];
		if (target === undefined) return;
		event.preventDefault();
		stepSnap(target);
	};

	return (
		<button
			type="button"
			role="slider"
			aria-label="Resize sheet"
			aria-orientation="vertical"
			aria-valuemin={0}
			aria-valuemax={snapCount - 1}
			aria-valuenow={snapIndex}
			aria-valuetext={snapLabel}
			data-slot="snap-sheet-handle"
			onClick={handleClick}
			onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
			className={cn(
				"group/handle mx-auto flex h-6 w-16 shrink-0 cursor-grab touch-none items-center justify-center rounded-full outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 group-data-[sheet-state=dragging]/sheet:cursor-grabbing",
				className,
			)}
			{...props}
		>
			<span className="h-[5px] w-9 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/35 transition-[width,background-color] duration-200 ease-out group-hover/handle:bg-muted-foreground/50 group-data-[sheet-state=dragging]/sheet:w-11 group-data-[sheet-state=dragging]/sheet:bg-muted-foreground/60" />
		</button>
	);
}

function SnapSheetTitle({ className, ...props }: DialogPrimitive.Title.Props) {
	return (
		<DialogPrimitive.Title
			data-slot="snap-sheet-title"
			className={cn("font-semibold text-base text-foreground", className)}
			{...props}
		/>
	);
}

function SnapSheetDescription({
	className,
	...props
}: DialogPrimitive.Description.Props) {
	return (
		<DialogPrimitive.Description
			data-slot="snap-sheet-description"
			className={cn("text-muted-foreground text-sm", className)}
			{...props}
		/>
	);
}

function SnapSheetClose({
	className,
	children,
	...props
}: DialogPrimitive.Close.Props) {
	return (
		<DialogPrimitive.Close
			data-slot="snap-sheet-close"
			className={cn(
				!children &&
					"inline-flex size-8 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-muted text-muted-foreground outline-none transition-colors hover:text-foreground focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50",
				className,
			)}
			{...props}
		>
			{children ?? (
				<>
					<XIcon className="size-4" />
					<span className="sr-only">Close</span>
				</>
			)}
		</DialogPrimitive.Close>
	);
}

SnapSheet.Trigger = SnapSheetTrigger;
SnapSheet.Content = SnapSheetContent;
SnapSheet.Handle = SnapSheetHandle;
SnapSheet.Title = SnapSheetTitle;
SnapSheet.Description = SnapSheetDescription;
SnapSheet.Close = SnapSheetClose;

export {
	SnapSheet,
	SnapSheetClose,
	SnapSheetContent,
	SnapSheetDescription,
	SnapSheetHandle,
	SnapSheetTitle,
	SnapSheetTrigger,
};

tick-ruler.name: tick-ruler
tick-ruler.title: Tick Ruler
tick-ruler.description: A ruler-style number picker you drag or flick, with a click and a haptic tick on every step.

"use client";

import { useTiks } from "@rexa-developer/tiks/react";
import {
	AnimatePresence,
	type AnimationPlaybackControls,
	animate,
	motion,
	useMotionValue,
	useReducedMotion,
} from "motion/react";
import {
	type KeyboardEvent,
	memo,
	type PointerEvent,
	useCallback,
	useEffect,
	useLayoutEffect,
	useRef,
	useState,
} from "react";
import { useWebHaptics } from "web-haptics/react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const landingSpring = { type: "spring", stiffness: 420, damping: 38 } as const;
const digitTransition = { duration: 0.18, ease: [0.23, 1, 0.32, 1] } as const;

/** Seconds of release velocity that a flick coasts before it snaps. */
const COAST_SECONDS = 0.25;
/** Fastest release, in px/s, so one jumpy pointer event can't fling the range. */
const MAX_VELOCITY = 4000;
/** Furthest the strip travels past a bound, in px. */
const MAX_OVERSHOOT = 40;
/** Minimum ms between step sounds and haptics. */
const TICK_THROTTLE_MS = 35;
/** Pointer travel, in px, below which a press counts as a tap. */
const TAP_SLOP = 5;
/** Ranges with more ticks than this render only the ticks near the needle. */
const WINDOW_THRESHOLD = 400;

const sizes = {
	sm: { spacing: 8, track: "h-14", readout: "text-3xl", unit: "text-sm" },
	md: { spacing: 10, track: "h-16", readout: "text-5xl", unit: "text-base" },
	lg: { spacing: 12, track: "h-20", readout: "text-6xl", unit: "text-lg" },
} as const;

type Orientation = "horizontal" | "vertical";
type RulerState = "idle" | "dragging" | "coasting";

export interface TickRulerProps {
	/** Controlled value. */
	value?: number;
	/** Initial value when uncontrolled; double-click resets to it. */
	defaultValue?: number;
	/** Called every time the needle crosses onto a new step. */
	onValueChange?: (value: number) => void;
	/** Called once the ruler settles after a drag, flick, key, wheel, or preset. */
	onValueCommit?: (value: number) => void;
	min?: number;
	max?: number;
	step?: number;
	/** Steps between medium ticks. */
	majorEvery?: number;
	/** Steps between labelled ticks. */
	labelEvery?: number;
	/** Pixels between ticks. Defaults by `size`. */
	spacing?: number;
	/** Unit shown after the readout, e.g. `min`. */
	unit?: string;
	/** Formats the readout and `aria-valuetext`. */
	format?: (value: number) => string;
	/** Values shown as chips that glide the ruler to them. */
	presets?: number[];
	/** Play a click per step and a pop at the bounds. */
	sound?: boolean;
	/** Trigger haptics on supported devices. */
	haptics?: boolean;
	disabled?: boolean;
	/** Accessible name for the slider. */
	label?: string;
	className?: string;
	size?: keyof typeof sizes;
	orientation?: Orientation;
	/** Show the large value readout above the ruler. */
	showValue?: boolean;
}

function decimalsOf(value: number) {
	const text = String(value);
	if (text.includes("e-")) return Number(text.split("e-")[1]);
	return text.split(".")[1]?.length ?? 0;
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number) {
	return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
}

/** Pulls travel past a bound back so it never exceeds `MAX_OVERSHOOT`. */
function rubberBand(position: number, maxPosition: number) {
	if (position < 0) {
		const over = -position;
		return -(MAX_OVERSHOOT * over) / (over + MAX_OVERSHOOT);
	}
	if (position > maxPosition) {
		const over = position - maxPosition;
		return maxPosition + (MAX_OVERSHOOT * over) / (over + MAX_OVERSHOOT);
	}
	return position;
}

type DigitSlot = { char: string; id: number };

let nextDigitId = 0;

/** Aligns `text` to `previous` from the right, keeping ids of unchanged chars. */
function toSlots(text: string, previous: DigitSlot[]): DigitSlot[] {
	const chars = text.split("");
	return chars.map((char, index) => {
		const match = previous[previous.length - chars.length + index];
		if (match?.char === char) return match;
		nextDigitId += 1;
		return { char, id: nextDigitId };
	});
}

function RollingValue({
	text,
	direction,
	animated,
}: {
	text: string;
	direction: number;
	animated: boolean;
}) {
	// Each slot gets a fresh key whenever its character changes. Reusing a key
	// while its previous copy is still exiting can leave the digit hidden.
	const [slots, setSlots] = useState(() => toSlots(text, []));
	const [previousText, setPreviousText] = useState(text);
	if (text !== previousText) {
		setPreviousText(text);
		setSlots((previous) => toSlots(text, previous));
	}

	if (!animated) return <span>{text}</span>;

	return (
		<span className="inline-flex">
			{slots.map(({ char, id }, index) => (
				// Keyed from the right so units digits stay put as the width changes.
				<span key={slots.length - index} className="relative inline-block">
					<AnimatePresence mode="popLayout" initial={false} custom={direction}>
						<motion.span
							key={id}
							custom={direction}
							className="inline-block"
							variants={{
								enter: (d: number) => ({ y: d * 12, opacity: 0 }),
								center: { y: 0, opacity: 1 },
								exit: (d: number) => ({ y: d * -12, opacity: 0 }),
							}}
							initial="enter"
							animate="center"
							exit="exit"
							transition={digitTransition}
						>
							{char}
						</motion.span>
					</AnimatePresence>
				</span>
			))}
		</span>
	);
}

const TickStrip = memo(function TickStrip({
	start,
	end,
	spacing,
	sign,
	orientation,
	majorEvery,
	labelEvery,
	labelAt,
}: {
	start: number;
	end: number;
	spacing: number;
	sign: number;
	orientation: Orientation;
	majorEvery: number;
	labelEvery: number;
	labelAt: (index: number) => string;
}) {
	const horizontal = orientation === "horizontal";
	const ticks = [];
	for (let index = start; index <= end; index++) {
		const kind =
			index % labelEvery === 0
				? "label"
				: index % majorEvery === 0
					? "major"
					: "minor";
		const offset = sign * index * spacing;
		ticks.push(
			<span
				key={index}
				data-kind={kind}
				className={cn(
					"absolute flex items-center gap-1.5",
					horizontal
						? "top-0 -translate-x-1/2 flex-col"
						: "left-0 -translate-y-1/2 flex-row",
				)}
				style={horizontal ? { left: offset } : { top: offset }}
			>
				<span
					className={cn(
						"rounded-full",
						horizontal ? "w-px" : "h-px",
						kind === "minor" && "bg-muted-foreground/35",
						kind === "minor" && (horizontal ? "h-3" : "w-3"),
						kind === "major" && "bg-muted-foreground/60",
						kind === "major" && (horizontal ? "h-5" : "w-5"),
						kind === "label" && "bg-foreground/80",
						kind === "label" &&
							(horizontal ? "h-7 w-[1.5px]" : "h-[1.5px] w-7"),
					)}
				/>
				{kind === "label" ? (
					<span className="font-medium text-[11px] text-muted-foreground tabular-nums leading-none">
						{labelAt(index)}
					</span>
				) : null}
			</span>,
		);
	}
	return <>{ticks}</>;
});

export function TickRuler({
	value: valueProp,
	defaultValue,
	onValueChange,
	onValueCommit,
	min = 0,
	max = 100,
	step = 1,
	majorEvery = 5,
	labelEvery = 10,
	spacing: spacingProp,
	unit,
	format,
	presets,
	sound = true,
	haptics = true,
	disabled = false,
	label = "Value",
	className,
	size = "md",
	orientation = "horizontal",
	showValue = true,
}: TickRulerProps) {
	const sizeStyle = sizes[size];
	const spacing = spacingProp ?? sizeStyle.spacing;
	const horizontal = orientation === "horizontal";
	const decimals = Math.max(decimalsOf(step), decimalsOf(min));
	const maxIndex = Math.max(0, Math.round((max - min) / step));
	const maxPosition = maxIndex * spacing;

	const indexToValue = useCallback(
		(index: number) => Number((min + index * step).toFixed(decimals)),
		[min, step, decimals],
	);
	const valueToIndex = useCallback(
		(value: number) => clamp(Math.round((value - min) / step), 0, maxIndex),
		[min, step, maxIndex],
	);
	const formatValue = useCallback(
		(value: number) => (format ? format(value) : value.toFixed(decimals)),
		[format, decimals],
	);

	const initialIndex = valueToIndex(valueProp ?? defaultValue ?? min);
	const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(initialIndex);
	const [direction, setDirection] = useState(1);
	const [sign, setSign] = useState(horizontal ? 1 : -1);
	const [range, setRange] = useState(() =>
		maxIndex + 1 <= WINDOW_THRESHOLD
			? { start: 0, end: maxIndex }
			: {
					start: Math.max(0, initialIndex - 60),
					end: Math.min(maxIndex, initialIndex + 60),
				},
	);

	const shouldReduceMotion = useReducedMotion() ?? false;
	const { trigger: haptic } = useWebHaptics();
	const { click: playClick, pop: playPop } = useTiks({
		// Sound stays on under reduced motion; only movement is reduced.
		respectReducedMotion: false,
	});

	const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
	const trackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
	const position = useMotionValue(initialIndex * spacing);
	const stripOffset = useMotionValue(0);
	const centerRef = useRef(0);
	const indexRef = useRef(initialIndex);
	const animationRef = useRef<AnimationPlaybackControls | null>(null);
	const silentRef = useRef(false);
	const interactingRef = useRef(false);
	const lastTickAtRef = useRef(Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);
	const chunkRef = useRef(-1);
	const wheelRef = useRef({ accumulated: 0, target: initialIndex });
	const dragRef = useRef<{
		pointerId: number;
		start: number;
		startPosition: number;
		moved: boolean;
		scale: number;
	} | null>(null);

	// Latest values for the imperative listeners below, so they never re-bind.
	const latest = useRef({
		sound,
		haptics,
		onValueChange,
		onValueCommit,
		indexToValue,
		maxIndex,
		maxPosition,
		spacing,
		sign,
		labelEvery,
	});
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		latest.current = {
			sound,
			haptics,
			onValueChange,
			onValueCommit,
			indexToValue,
			maxIndex,
			maxPosition,
			spacing,
			sign,
			labelEvery,
		};
	});

	const setRulerState = useCallback((state: RulerState) => {
		if (rootRef.current) rootRef.current.dataset.state = state;
	}, []);

	const updateRange = useCallback((pos: number) => {
		const { maxIndex, spacing } = latest.current;
		if (maxIndex + 1 <= WINDOW_THRESHOLD) {
			if (chunkRef.current !== 0) {
				chunkRef.current = 0;
				setRange({ start: 0, end: maxIndex });
			}
			return;
		}
		const visible = Math.ceil((centerRef.current * 2) / spacing) || 60;
		const chunkSize = Math.max(40, visible);
		const chunk = Math.floor(pos / spacing / chunkSize);
		if (chunk === chunkRef.current) return;
		chunkRef.current = chunk;
		setRange({
			start: Math.max(0, (chunk - 1) * chunkSize),
			end: Math.min(maxIndex, (chunk + 2) * chunkSize),
		});
	}, []);

	// The one place that reacts to movement: transforms, ticks, and feedback.
	useEffect(() => {
		const sync = (pos: number) => {
			const {
				sign,
				spacing,
				maxIndex,
				indexToValue,
				labelEvery,
				sound,
				haptics,
				onValueChange,
			} = latest.current;
			stripOffset.set(centerRef.current - sign * pos);
			updateRange(pos);

			const index = clamp(Math.round(pos / spacing), 0, maxIndex);
			const previous = indexRef.current;
			if (index === previous) return;
			indexRef.current = index;
			setCurrentIndex(index);
			setDirection(index > previous ? 1 : -1);
			if (silentRef.current) return;

			onValueChange?.(indexToValue(index));
			const now = performance.now();
			const atBound = index === 0 || index === maxIndex;
			// Bounds always sound so a fast flick still ends on the pop.
			if (!atBound && now - lastTickAtRef.current < TICK_THROTTLE_MS) return;
			lastTickAtRef.current = now;
			if (atBound) {
				if (sound) playPop();
				if (haptics) void haptic("rigid");
			} else {
				if (sound) playClick();
				if (haptics)
					void haptic(index % labelEvery === 0 ? "light" : "selection");
			}
		};
		sync(position.get());
		return position.on("change", sync);
	}, [haptic, playClick, playPop, position, stripOffset, updateRange]);

	// Track size and direction.
	useLayoutEffect(() => {
		const track = trackRef.current;
		if (!track) return;
		const measure = () => {
			const rtl = getComputedStyle(track).direction === "rtl";
			const nextSign = horizontal ? (rtl ? -1 : 1) : -1;
			latest.current.sign = nextSign;
			setSign(nextSign);
			centerRef.current =
				(horizontal ? track.offsetWidth : track.offsetHeight) / 2;
			chunkRef.current = -1;
			stripOffset.set(centerRef.current - nextSign * position.get());
			updateRange(position.get());
		};
		measure();
		const observer = new ResizeObserver(measure);
		observer.observe(track);
		return () => observer.disconnect();
	}, [horizontal, position, stripOffset, updateRange]);

	// Spacing or range changes keep the current step under the needle.
	// biome-ignore lint/correctness/useExhaustiveDependencies: re-run when the range changes too
	useEffect(() => {
		chunkRef.current = -1;
		position.jump(indexRef.current * spacing);
	}, [position, spacing, maxIndex]);

	const stop = useCallback(() => {
		animationRef.current?.stop();
		animationRef.current = null;
	}, []);

	const settle = useCallback(
		(
			targetIndex: number,
			{
				velocity = 0,
				silent = false,
				onLand,
			}: { velocity?: number; silent?: boolean; onLand?: () => void } = {},
		) => {
			stop();
			const target = clamp(targetIndex, 0, latest.current.maxIndex);
			const targetPosition = target * latest.current.spacing;
			silentRef.current = silent;
			const finish = () => {
				animationRef.current = null;
				silentRef.current = false;
				setRulerState("idle");
				if (!silent) {
					latest.current.onValueCommit?.(latest.current.indexToValue(target));
					onLand?.();
				}
			};
			if (shouldReduceMotion || position.get() === targetPosition) {
				position.jump(targetPosition);
				finish();
				return;
			}
			setRulerState("coasting");
			animationRef.current = animate(position, targetPosition, {
				...landingSpring,
				velocity,
				restDelta: 0.01,
				onComplete: finish,
			});
		},
		[position, setRulerState, shouldReduceMotion, stop],
	);

	// Controlled value: glide there silently unless the user is interacting.
	useEffect(() => {
		if (valueProp === undefined || interactingRef.current) return;
		const target = valueToIndex(valueProp);
		if (target === indexRef.current && !animationRef.current) return;
		if (animationRef.current && !silentRef.current) return;
		settle(target, { silent: true });
	}, [valueProp, valueToIndex, settle]);

	useEffect(() => stop, [stop]);

	const pointerAxis = (event: PointerEvent) =>
		horizontal ? event.clientX : event.clientY;

	const handlePointerDown = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		if (disabled || event.button !== 0) return;
		const track = event.currentTarget;
		track.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
		track.focus({ preventScroll: true });
		stop();
		silentRef.current = false;
		interactingRef.current = true;
		const rect = track.getBoundingClientRect();
		// CSS zoom and transforms scale client coordinates; work in local px.
		const scale = horizontal
			? rect.width / (track.offsetWidth || 1)
			: rect.height / (track.offsetHeight || 1);
		dragRef.current = {
			pointerId: event.pointerId,
			start: pointerAxis(event),
			startPosition: position.get(),
			moved: false,
			scale: scale || 1,
		};
	};

	const handlePointerMove = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		const drag = dragRef.current;
		if (!drag || drag.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
		const delta = (pointerAxis(event) - drag.start) / drag.scale;
		if (!drag.moved) {
			if (Math.abs(delta) < TAP_SLOP) return;
			drag.moved = true;
			setRulerState("dragging");
		}
		const raw = drag.startPosition - sign * delta;
		position.set(rubberBand(raw, maxPosition));
	};

	const handlePointerUp = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		const drag = dragRef.current;
		if (!drag || drag.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
		dragRef.current = null;
		interactingRef.current = false;
		const track = event.currentTarget;
		if (track.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
			track.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
		}

		if (!drag.moved) {
			// Tap: glide to the tick under the pointer.
			const rect = track.getBoundingClientRect();
			const local =
				(pointerAxis(event) - (horizontal ? rect.left : rect.top)) / drag.scale;
			const offset = sign * (local - centerRef.current);
			settle(Math.round((position.get() + offset) / spacing));
			return;
		}

		const velocity = clamp(position.getVelocity(), -MAX_VELOCITY, MAX_VELOCITY);
		const current = position.get();
		const coast = shouldReduceMotion ? 0 : velocity * COAST_SECONDS;
		const target = clamp(current + coast, 0, maxPosition);
		settle(Math.round(target / spacing), { velocity });
	};

	const handlePointerCancel = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		if (dragRef.current?.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
		dragRef.current = null;
		interactingRef.current = false;
		settle(Math.round(clamp(position.get(), 0, maxPosition) / spacing));
	};

	const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
		if (disabled) return;
		const stepBy = event.shiftKey ? 10 : 1;
		const flip = horizontal && sign < 0 ? -1 : 1;
		// Repeated keys build on the pending target, not the moving needle.
		const from = animationRef.current
			? wheelRef.current.target
			: indexRef.current;
		let target: number | null = null;
		switch (event.key) {
			case "ArrowRight":
				target = from + stepBy * flip;
				break;
			case "ArrowLeft":
				target = from - stepBy * flip;
				break;
			case "ArrowUp":
				target = from + stepBy;
				break;
			case "ArrowDown":
				target = from - stepBy;
				break;
			case "PageUp":
				target = from + 10;
				break;
			case "PageDown":
				target = from - 10;
				break;
			case "Home":
				target = 0;
				break;
			case "End":
				target = maxIndex;
				break;
			default:
				return;
		}
		event.preventDefault();
		target = clamp(target, 0, maxIndex);
		wheelRef.current.target = target;
		settle(target);
	};

	// Wheel needs a non-passive listener to keep the page from scrolling.
	useEffect(() => {
		const track = trackRef.current;
		if (!track || disabled) return;
		const onWheel = (event: WheelEvent) => {
			const { sign, maxIndex, spacing } = latest.current;
			const along = horizontal ? event.deltaX : event.deltaY;
			const across = horizontal ? event.deltaY : event.deltaX;
			let delta = 0;
			if (Math.abs(along) >= Math.abs(across)) {
				delta = sign * along;
			} else if (horizontal && document.activeElement === track) {
				// A plain mouse wheel only drives a focused horizontal ruler.
				delta = -across;
			} else {
				return;
			}
			event.preventDefault();
			const wheel = wheelRef.current;
			if (!animationRef.current) wheel.target = indexRef.current;
			let steps = 0;
			if (event.deltaMode !== 0 || Math.abs(delta) >= 50) {
				// One notch, one step.
				steps = Math.sign(delta);
				wheel.accumulated = 0;
			} else {
				wheel.accumulated += delta;
				steps = Math.trunc(wheel.accumulated / spacing);
				wheel.accumulated -= steps * spacing;
			}
			if (steps === 0) return;
			const target = clamp(wheel.target + steps, 0, maxIndex);
			if (target === wheel.target) return;
			wheel.target = target;
			settle(target);
		};
		track.addEventListener("wheel", onWheel, { passive: false });
		return () => track.removeEventListener("wheel", onWheel);
	}, [disabled, horizontal, settle]);

	// iOS can still scroll the page under a captured pointer; block it mid-drag.
	useEffect(() => {
		const track = trackRef.current;
		if (!track) return;
		const onTouchMove = (event: TouchEvent) => {
			if (dragRef.current?.moved) event.preventDefault();
		};
		track.addEventListener("touchmove", onTouchMove, { passive: false });
		return () => track.removeEventListener("touchmove", onTouchMove);
	}, []);

	const currentValue = indexToValue(currentIndex);
	const valueText = format
		? format(currentValue)
		: `${formatValue(currentValue)}${unit ? ` ${unit}` : ""}`;
	const labelAt = useCallback(
		(index: number) => indexToValue(index).toFixed(decimals),
		[indexToValue, decimals],
	);
	const defaultIndex = valueToIndex(defaultValue ?? min);

	return (
		<div
			ref={rootRef}
			data-slot="tick-ruler"
			data-state="idle"
			data-orientation={orientation}
			data-disabled={disabled || undefined}
			data-bound={
				currentIndex === 0
					? "min"
					: currentIndex === maxIndex
						? "max"
						: undefined
			}
			className={cn(
				"group/ruler flex select-none gap-4 [--tick-ruler-accent:var(--color-orange-500)] data-disabled:opacity-50",
				horizontal ? "w-full flex-col items-center" : "flex-row items-center",
				className,
			)}
		>
			{showValue ? (
				<div
					aria-hidden
					data-slot="tick-ruler-value"
					className={cn(
						"flex items-baseline gap-1.5 font-semibold text-foreground tabular-nums tracking-tight",
						sizeStyle.readout,
					)}
				>
					<RollingValue
						text={formatValue(currentValue)}
						direction={direction}
						animated={!shouldReduceMotion}
					/>
					{unit && !format ? (
						<span
							className={cn(
								"font-medium text-muted-foreground tracking-normal",
								sizeStyle.unit,
							)}
						>
							{unit}
						</span>
					) : null}
				</div>
			) : null}

			<div
				ref={trackRef}
				role="slider"
				tabIndex={disabled ? -1 : 0}
				aria-label={label}
				aria-orientation={orientation}
				aria-valuemin={min}
				aria-valuemax={max}
				aria-valuenow={currentValue}
				aria-valuetext={valueText}
				aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
				data-slot="tick-ruler-track"
				onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
				onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
				onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
				onPointerCancel={handlePointerCancel}
				onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
				onDoubleClick={() => {
					if (!disabled) settle(defaultIndex);
				}}
				className={cn(
					"relative cursor-grab overflow-hidden rounded-lg outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 group-data-disabled/ruler:pointer-events-none group-data-[state=dragging]/ruler:cursor-grabbing",
					horizontal
						? cn(
								"w-full touch-pan-y [mask-image:linear-gradient(to_right,transparent,black_18%,black_82%,transparent)]",
								sizeStyle.track,
							)
						: "h-64 w-20 touch-none [mask-image:linear-gradient(to_bottom,transparent,black_18%,black_82%,transparent)]",
				)}
			>
				<motion.div
					aria-hidden
					className={cn(
						"absolute will-change-transform",
						horizontal ? "top-2 left-0" : "top-0 left-3",
					)}
					style={horizontal ? { x: stripOffset } : { y: stripOffset }}
				>
					<TickStrip
						start={range.start}
						end={range.end}
						spacing={spacing}
						sign={sign}
						orientation={orientation}
						majorEvery={majorEvery}
						labelEvery={labelEvery}
						labelAt={labelAt}
					/>
				</motion.div>

				<span
					aria-hidden
					data-slot="tick-ruler-needle"
					className={cn(
						"pointer-events-none absolute rounded-full bg-[var(--tick-ruler-accent)] transition-[transform,box-shadow] duration-200 ease-out group-hover/ruler:scale-110 group-data-[state=dragging]/ruler:scale-115 group-data-[state=dragging]/ruler:shadow-[0_0_12px_2px_var(--tick-ruler-accent)]",
						horizontal
							? "top-1 left-1/2 h-9 w-[3px] origin-top -translate-x-1/2"
							: "top-1/2 left-1 h-[3px] w-11 origin-left -translate-y-1/2",
					)}
				/>
			</div>

			{presets?.length ? (
				<div
					data-slot="tick-ruler-presets"
					className={cn(
						"flex flex-wrap gap-2",
						horizontal ? "justify-center" : "flex-col",
					)}
				>
					{presets.map((preset) => {
						const active = valueToIndex(preset) === currentIndex;
						return (
							<button
								key={preset}
								type="button"
								disabled={disabled}
								data-active={active || undefined}
								onClick={() =>
									settle(valueToIndex(preset), {
										onLand: () => {
											if (haptics) void haptic("nudge");
										},
									})
								}
								className="h-8 cursor-pointer rounded-full border border-border bg-background px-3.5 font-medium text-muted-foreground text-sm tabular-nums shadow-xs outline-none transition-[color,background-color,border-color] hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:pointer-events-none data-active:border-transparent data-active:bg-foreground data-active:text-background dark:border-input dark:bg-input/30 dark:data-active:bg-foreground"
							>
								{format ? format(preset) : formatValue(preset)}
								{unit && !format ? ` ${unit}` : null}
							</button>
						);
					})}
				</div>
			) : null}
		</div>
	);
}

hold-to-confirm.name: hold-to-confirm
hold-to-confirm.title: Hold to Confirm
hold-to-confirm.description: Guard destructive actions behind a press-and-hold fill with rising sound, haptic ticks, and a checkmark.
